176	def _compute_rollout_moe_load_balance_metrics_from_counts(
177	    load_counts: torch.Tensor | None,
178	    prefix: str = "rollout/moe",
179	) -> dict[str, Any]:
180	    if load_counts is None or load_counts.numel() == 0:
181	        return {}
182	
183	    load_matrix = load_counts.float()
184	    load_matrix = load_matrix / load_matrix.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp_min(1.0)
185	    num_experts = load_matrix.shape[1]
186	    deviation = load_matrix * num_experts - 1.0
187	    max_vio = deviation.max(dim=1).values
188	    min_vio = deviation.min(dim=1).values
189	    avg_vio = deviation.abs().mean(dim=1)
190	
191	    metrics: dict[str, Any] = {}
192	    for i in range(load_matrix.shape[0]):
193	        metrics[f"{prefix}/max_vio/layer_{i}"] = max_vio[i].detach().item()
194	        metrics[f"{prefix}/min_vio/layer_{i}"] = min_vio[i].detach().item()
195	        metrics[f"{prefix}/avg_vio/layer_{i}"] = avg_vio[i].detach().item()
196	    metrics[f"{prefix}/max_vio/max"] = max_vio.max().detach().item()
197	    metrics[f"{prefix}/max_vio/avg"] = max_vio.mean().detach().item()
198	    metrics[f"{prefix}/min_vio/max"] = min_vio.max().detach().item()
199	    metrics[f"{prefix}/min_vio/avg"] = min_vio.mean().detach().item()
200	    metrics[f"{prefix}/avg_vio/max"] = avg_vio.max().detach().item()
201	    metrics[f"{prefix}/avg_vio/avg"] = avg_vio.mean().detach().item()
202	    return metrics

205	def _compute_rollout_moe_load_counts(
206	    routed_experts: torch.Tensor | None,
207	    response_mask: torch.Tensor | None,
208	    num_experts: int | None,
209	) -> torch.Tensor | None:
210	    """Count routed experts in response tokens as [num_layers, num_experts].
211	
212	    Each sequence's last valid response position is excluded: that token is
213	    sampled but never fed back through the model, so it carries no routing
214	    record (its slot is filler, not data).
215	    """
216	    if routed_experts is None or response_mask is None or num_experts is None or num_experts <= 0:
217	        return None
218	    if routed_experts.dim() != 4:
219	        logger.warning("Expected routed_experts with shape [bsz, seqlen, layers, topk], got %s", routed_experts.shape)
220	        return None
221	    if response_mask.dim() != 2 or response_mask.shape[0] != routed_experts.shape[0]:
222	        logger.warning(
223	            "Response mask shape %s is incompatible with routed_experts %s", response_mask.shape, routed_experts.shape
224	        )
225	        return None
226	
227	    response_len = response_mask.shape[1]
228	    if response_len == 0:
229	        return None
230	    if routed_experts.shape[1] < response_len:
231	        logger.warning(
232	            "routed_experts sequence length %s is shorter than response length %s",
233	            routed_experts.shape[1],
234	            response_len,
235	        )
236	        return None
237	
238	    response_routed_experts = routed_experts[:, -response_len:]
239	    response_mask = response_mask.to(device=response_routed_experts.device, dtype=torch.bool)
240	    # The final response token is sampled but never fed back through the model,
241	    # so it has no routing record; its slot holds filler from batch assembly
242	    # (zeros, see AgentLoopWorker._postprocess). Counting it would credit
243	    # expert 0 with num_layers * topk phantom assignments per sequence, so drop
244	    # each sequence's last valid position. This is the metrics counterpart of
245	    # build_r3_replay_mask, which skips the same row on the replay side.
246	    positions = torch.arange(response_len, device=response_mask.device)
247	    last_valid = torch.where(response_mask, positions, positions.new_full((), -1)).amax(dim=-1)
248	    has_valid = last_valid >= 0
249	    is_last_valid = (positions.unsqueeze(0) == last_valid.unsqueeze(1)) & has_valid.unsqueeze(1)
250	    response_mask = response_mask & ~is_last_valid
251	    selected = response_routed_experts[response_mask]
252	    selected = selected.detach().to(device="cpu", dtype=torch.long)
253	    if selected.numel() == 0:
254	        return None
255	    if selected.min() < 0 or selected.max() >= num_experts:
256	        logger.warning(
257	            "Skipping rollout MoE load-balance metrics because routed expert ids are outside [0, %s): min=%s max=%s",
258	            num_experts,
259	            selected.min().item(),
260	            selected.max().item(),
261	        )
262	        return None
263	
264	    # selected: [num_response_tokens, num_layers, topk]. Count every top-k slot
265	    # without materializing a large [tokens, layers, topk, experts] one-hot tensor.
266	    return torch.stack(
267	        [
268	            torch.bincount(selected[:, layer_idx, :].flatten(), minlength=num_experts)
269	            for layer_idx in range(selected.shape[1])
270	        ]
271	    )

43	        if key.endswith("/evicted_samples_staleness/mean"):
44	            denom = prev_stale_total + stale_count
45	            acc[key] = (acc.get(key, 0.0) * prev_stale_total + value * stale_count) / denom if denom else value
46	        elif key.endswith("/evicted_samples_staleness/max"):
47	            acc[key] = max(acc.get(key, value), value)
48	        elif key.endswith("/evicted_samples_staleness/min"):
49	            acc[key] = min(acc.get(key, value), value)
50	        elif key == DAPO_FILTERED_REWARD_COUNTS_KEY:
51	            # Dict-valued diagnostic: merge {metric_value: count} across poll iterations.
52	            merged = Counter(acc.get(key, {}))
53	            merged.update(value)
54	            acc[key] = dict(merged)
55	        else:
56	            acc[key] = acc.get(key, 0) + value

63	class ReplayBuffer:
64	    """ReplayBuffer is used by trainer to sample trajectories produced during rollout.
65	
66	    We use [TransferQueue](https://github.com/Ascend/TransferQueue) as kv store to store trajectories.
67	
68	    ### [Trajectories storage format]
69	    The key format is `{uid}_{session_id}_{index}`, where:
70	    - uid: Auto generated unique id when prompt is sampled from dataset.
71	    - session_id: Session id for GRPO group sampling: [0, n).
72	    - index: Index of output trajectory in a session.
73	
74	    There're two types of data associated with each key: tag and value. The tag are arbitrary metadata:
75	    `{"status": "running", ...}` used to track the status of the trajectory.
76	
77	    The value is a dictionary containing the following fields:
78	    - messages/datasource/reward_model/...: fields from dataset.
79	    - prompt_ids/response_ids/response_mask/...: fields from AgentLoopOutput.
80	
81	    TransferQueue store tag and value separately, the tag are stored in meta server, while the value is stored
82	    in storage units.
83	
84	    ### [GRPO group sampling control]
85	    Except trajectories, we also store raw prompts in TransferQueue with key `{uid}`, with `status` tag to track
86	    status of GRPO group sampling.
87	    - pending: the prompt is sampled from dataset but its sessions are not yet started.
88	    - running: all sessions of the prompt are running.
89	    - finished: all sessions of the prompt are finished without error.
90	    - failure: all sessions of the prompt are finished, but at least one session failed.
91	    Only prompts with status `finished` or `failure` enter terminal-group handling.
92	
93	    ### [Terminal-group eviction/refill matrix]
94	    ``drop`` means off-policy staleness dropping. Both off-policy strategies (``drop`` and the dropless
95	    ``wait``, which blocks until stale in-flight prompts finish) are only for async trainers; sync sampling
96	    is on-policy, so ``max_off_policy_strategy`` is a NO-OP there.
97	    ``DAPO`` means filtering groups whose configured reward metric is identical across all trajectories,
98	             for async reward-computation path.
99	    ``failure`` is the group status described above.
100	    The matrix applies to the training partition, in which ``k`` is the number of prompts to evict.
101	    Validation treats all terminal groups as sampleable
102	
103	    |   trainer mode   |   drop   |               DAPO               |            failure            |
104	    | ---------------- | -------- | -------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
105	    |       sync       |   NO-OP  |    Evict ``k``; refill ``2k``    |  NO-OP or opt-in refill ``k`` |
106	    |      async       |              All the same: Evict ``k``; refill ``k``.                       |
107	
108	    In sync mode, DAPO is opt-in and trades generation time for training stability. Each ``k`` evictions add
109	    ``2k`` logical refill credits, but prompts are fetched only as bounded pending/running slots become available.
110	    Terminal groups are filtered while other requests remain in flight. Once enough groups are sampleable, inflight
111	    requests are drained and discarded. By default, failed groups remain sampleable and missing trajectories are
112	    padded downstream. Setting ``sync_refill_failed_groups=True`` allows refilling failed samples.
113	    In async mode, ``num_warmup_batches`` absorbs retry cost, so all three paths refill exactly ``k`` prompts.
114	
115	    Args:
116	        trainer_mode (str): Trainer mode.
117	        trainer_config (DictConfig): Trainer configuration.
118	        max_off_policy_threshold (int): Maximum number of model versions that trajectory can span.
119	        max_off_policy_strategy (str): How to handle trajectory that exceeds the maximum number of model versions.
120	        sampler_kwargs (dict): Additional kwargs for the custom sampler.
121	        poll_interval (float, optional): Poll interval in seconds. Defaults to 2.0.
122	        refill_fn (callable, optional): Trainer-injected function that submits an exact number of fresh prompts.
123	        filter_groups_metric (str, optional): DAPO group-filtering metric read from each trajectory's
124	            ``extra_fields.reward_extra_info``. ``None`` disables DAPO filtering.
125	        train_batch_size (int, optional): Prompt count represented by one Sync DAPO in-flight batch.
126	        gen_batch_size (int, optional): Dataloader fetch granularity for refill dispatches.
127	        max_inflight_gen_batches (int): Maximum Sync DAPO prompt batches concurrently pending or running.
128	        sync_refill_failed_groups (bool): Whether sync sampling replaces failed groups with no trajectories.
129	    """
130	
131	    def __init__(
132	        self,
133	        trainer_mode: str,
134	        trainer_config: DictConfig,
135	        max_off_policy_threshold: int,
136	        max_off_policy_strategy: str,
137	        sampler_kwargs: DictConfig,
138	        poll_interval: float = 2.0,
139	        refill_fn=None,
140	        filter_groups_metric: str | None = None,
141	        train_batch_size: int | None = None,
142	        gen_batch_size: int | None = None,
143	        max_inflight_gen_batches: int = 1,
144	        sync_refill_failed_groups: bool = False,
145	    ):
146	        self.trainer_mode = trainer_mode
147	        self.trainer_config = trainer_config
148	        self.max_off_policy_threshold = max_off_policy_threshold
149	        self.max_off_policy_strategy = max_off_policy_strategy
150	        self.sampler_kwargs = sampler_kwargs
151	        self.poll_interval = poll_interval
152	        self.refill_fn = refill_fn
153	        self.filter_groups_metric = filter_groups_metric
154	        self.train_batch_size = train_batch_size
155	        self.gen_batch_size = gen_batch_size
156	        self.max_inflight_gen_batches = max_inflight_gen_batches
157	        self.sync_refill_failed_groups = sync_refill_failed_groups
158	
159	        assert isinstance(self.max_off_policy_threshold, int) and self.max_off_policy_threshold > 0, (
160	            f"Invalid max off policy threshold: {self.max_off_policy_threshold}, must be an integer greater than 0"
161	        )
162	        assert self.max_off_policy_strategy in ["drop", "wait"], (
163	            f"Invalid max off policy strategy: {self.max_off_policy_strategy}, must be one of ['drop', 'wait']"
164	        )
165	        if self.filter_groups_metric is not None and self.refill_fn is None:
166	            raise ValueError("Group filtering (filter_groups_metric) requires refill_fn to replace evicted groups")
167	        if self.sync_refill_failed_groups and self.refill_fn is None:
168	            raise ValueError("sync_refill_failed_groups requires refill_fn to replace failed groups")
169	        self._validate_mode_config()
170	        # partition_id => {key: tag}
171	        self.partitions: dict[str, dict[str, dict]] = defaultdict(dict)
172	        self.pending_keys: dict[str, set] = defaultdict(set)
173	        self.running_keys: dict[str, set] = defaultdict(set)
174	        self.finished_keys: dict[str, set] = defaultdict(set)
175	        self.failure_keys: dict[str, set] = defaultdict(set)
176	        # partition_id => {prompt_key: global_steps}, used to prioritize older samples.
177	        self.prompt_global_steps: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = defaultdict(dict)
178	        # Finished groups are immutable, so their DAPO classification can be reused across polling iterations.
179	        self._dapo_classification_cache: dict[str, dict[str, float | None]] = defaultdict(dict)
180	
181	    def _validate_mode_config(self) -> None:
182	        if self.filter_groups_metric is not None:
183	            if not isinstance(self.max_inflight_gen_batches, int) or self.max_inflight_gen_batches <= 0:
184	                raise ValueError("max_inflight_gen_batches must be a positive integer")
185	        if self.sync_refill_failed_groups and self.gen_batch_size != 1:
186	            raise ValueError("sync_refill_failed_groups requires gen_batch_size=1")

188	    def _sync_metadata_from_transfer_queue(self):
189	        """Sync the metadata from TransferQueue."""
190	        self.partitions.clear()
191	        self.pending_keys.clear()
192	        self.running_keys.clear()
193	        self.finished_keys.clear()
194	        self.failure_keys.clear()
195	        self.prompt_global_steps.clear()
196	
197	        data = tq.kv_list()
198	        if data is None:
199	            return
200	
201	        for partition_id, items in data.items():
202	            partition = self.partitions[partition_id]
203	            for key, tag in items.items():
204	                if tag.get("is_prompt", False):
205	                    # see: [GRPO group sampling control]
206	                    self.prompt_global_steps[partition_id][key] = tag["global_steps"]
207	                    match tag["status"]:
208	                        case "pending":
209	                            self.pending_keys[partition_id].add(key)
210	                        case "running":
211	                            self.running_keys[partition_id].add(key)
212	                        case "finished":
213	                            self.finished_keys[partition_id].add(key)
214	                        case "failure":
215	                            self.failure_keys[partition_id].add(key)
216	                        case _:
217	                            raise ValueError(f"Unknown status: {tag['status']}")
218	                else:
219	                    # see: [Trajectories storage format]
220	                    if key not in partition:
221	                        partition[key] = {}
222	                    partition[key].update(tag)

224	    @staticmethod
225	    def _metrics_prefix(partition_id: str) -> str:
226	        return "training" if partition_id == "train" else "validation"

228	    def _clear_groups(self, partition_id: str, uids: set[str]) -> None:
229	        """Remove prompt groups from TransferQueue and the active metadata snapshot."""
230	        if not uids:
231	            return
232	
233	        trajectory_keys = {key for key in self.partitions[partition_id] if key.split("_")[0] in uids}
234	        tq.kv_clear(
235	            partition_id=partition_id,
236	            keys=[*uids, *trajectory_keys],
237	        )
238	
239	        # Keep same-poll decisions consistent with tq.
240	        for key in trajectory_keys:
241	            del self.partitions[partition_id][key]
242	        for status_keys in (self.pending_keys, self.running_keys, self.finished_keys, self.failure_keys):
243	            status_keys[partition_id].difference_update(uids)
244	        for uid in uids:
245	            self.prompt_global_steps[partition_id].pop(uid, None)
246	            self._dapo_classification_cache[partition_id].pop(uid, None)
247	
248	    def _dapo_filtered_keys(self, partition_id: str) -> tuple[set[str], Counter]:
249	        """Finished groups whose configured DAPO metric is identical across all trajectories.
250	
251	        Returns the filtered uids and a ``{shared_metric_value: group_count}`` breakdown built in the
252	        same scope, so the diagnostic (which reward level the no-signal groups collapse to) travels
253	        with the uids through the return value instead of via hidden instance state.
254	        """
255	        if partition_id == "val" or self.filter_groups_metric is None:
256	            return set(), Counter()
257	
258	        finished_uids = self.finished_keys[partition_id]
259	        classification_cache = self._dapo_classification_cache[partition_id]
260	        for uid in classification_cache.keys() - finished_uids:
261	            del classification_cache[uid]
262	
263	        new_finished_uids = finished_uids - classification_cache.keys()
264	        trajectory_keys = [key for key in self.partitions[partition_id] if key.split("_")[0] in new_finished_uids]
265	        metrics_by_uid: dict[str, list[float]] = defaultdict(list)
266	        missing_metric_uids = new_finished_uids - {key.split("_")[0] for key in trajectory_keys}
267	
268	        if trajectory_keys:
269	            data = tq.kv_batch_get(
270	                keys=trajectory_keys,
271	                partition_id=partition_id,
272	                select_fields=["extra_fields"],
273	            )
274	            extra_fields_list = list(data["extra_fields"])
275	        else:
276	            extra_fields_list = []
277	
278	        for key, extra_fields in zip(trajectory_keys, extra_fields_list, strict=True):
279	            uid = key.split("_")[0]
280	            extra_fields = getattr(extra_fields, "data", extra_fields)
281	            reward_extra_info = extra_fields.get("reward_extra_info", {}) if isinstance(extra_fields, dict) else {}
282	            if self.filter_groups_metric not in reward_extra_info:
283	                missing_metric_uids.add(uid)
284	            else:
285	                metrics_by_uid[uid].append(float(reward_extra_info[self.filter_groups_metric]))
286	
287	        if missing_metric_uids:
288	            raise RuntimeError(
289	                f"Finished groups are missing DAPO metric {self.filter_groups_metric!r}: "
290	                f"{sorted(missing_metric_uids)[:5]}"
291	            )
292	
293	        for uid in new_finished_uids:
294	            values = metrics_by_uid[uid]
295	            classification_cache[uid] = float(values[0]) if len(values) > 1 and float(np.std(values)) == 0.0 else None
296	
297	        filtered_rewards = {uid: reward for uid, reward in classification_cache.items() if reward is not None}
298	        return set(filtered_rewards), Counter(filtered_rewards.values())
299	
300	    def _terminal_eviction_reasons(
301	        self, global_steps: int, partition_id: str
302	    ) -> tuple[set[str], set[str], set[str], Counter]:
303	        """Return stale, DAPO-filtered, and failed groups (plus the DAPO value->count breakdown).
304	
305	        The three sets may overlap. Callers clear and refill their union, so one prompt is never handled
306	        twice. ``dapo_counts`` is the {shared_metric_value: group_count} diagnostic for ``dapo_uids``; it
307	        rides along in the return value so no hidden state is needed between production and consumption.
308	        """
309	        if partition_id == "val":
310	            return set(), set(), set(), Counter()
311	
312	        dapo_uids, dapo_counts = self._dapo_filtered_keys(partition_id)
313	        failed_uids = set()
314	        if self.sync_refill_failed_groups:
315	            materializable_uids = {key.split("_")[0] for key in self.partitions[partition_id]}
316	            failed_uids = self.failure_keys[partition_id] - materializable_uids
317	        return set(), dapo_uids, failed_uids, dapo_counts
318	
319	    def _sampleable_terminal_keys(
320	        self,
321	        partition_id: str,
322	        eviction_reasons: tuple[set[str], set[str], set[str], Counter],
323	    ) -> set[str]:
324	        terminal_uids = self.finished_keys[partition_id] | self.failure_keys[partition_id]
325	        stale_uids, dapo_uids, failed_uids, _dapo_counts = eviction_reasons
326	        return terminal_uids - (stale_uids | dapo_uids | failed_uids)
327	
328	    def _evict_terminal_groups(
329	        self,
330	        global_steps: int,
331	        partition_id: str,
332	        eviction_reasons: tuple[set[str], set[str], set[str], Counter],
333	    ) -> tuple[set[str], int, int, dict]:
334	        """Evict terminal groups selected by any active policy exactly once."""
335	        stale_uids, dapo_uids, failed_uids, dapo_counts = eviction_reasons
336	        evicted_uids = stale_uids | dapo_uids | failed_uids
337	        if not evicted_uids:
338	            return set(), 0, 0, {}
339	
340	        prefix = self._metrics_prefix(partition_id)
341	        metrics: dict = {}
342	        if stale_uids:
343	            prompt_global_steps = self.prompt_global_steps[partition_id]
344	            spans = np.array(
345	                [global_steps - prompt_global_steps.get(uid, global_steps) + 1 for uid in stale_uids],
346	                dtype=float,
347	            )
348	            metrics.update(
349	                {
350	                    f"{prefix}/off_policy/evicted_samples": len(stale_uids),
351	                    f"{prefix}/off_policy/evicted_samples_staleness/mean": spans.mean(),
352	                    f"{prefix}/off_policy/evicted_samples_staleness/max": spans.max(),
353	                    f"{prefix}/off_policy/evicted_samples_staleness/min": spans.min(),
354	                }
355	            )
356	        if dapo_uids:
357	            metrics[f"{prefix}/filter_groups/evicted_samples"] = len(dapo_uids)
358	            # Non-scalar diagnostic: how many filtered (no-signal) groups collapsed to each metric value.
359	            metrics[DAPO_FILTERED_REWARD_COUNTS_KEY] = dict(dapo_counts)
360	        if failed_uids:
361	            metrics[f"{prefix}/rollout_failure/evicted_samples"] = len(failed_uids)
362	
363	        self._clear_groups(partition_id, evicted_uids)
364	        return evicted_uids, len(stale_uids), len(dapo_uids), metrics
365	
366	    def _select_prompt_uids(
367	        self, partition_id: str, sampleable_keys: set[str], batch_size: int
368	    ) -> tuple[list[str], dict[str, dict], dict[str, int]]:
369	        prompt_global_steps_snapshot = dict(self.prompt_global_steps[partition_id])
370	        partition_snapshot = dict(self.partitions[partition_id])
371	        ordered_keys = sorted(
372	            sampleable_keys,
373	            key=lambda key: prompt_global_steps_snapshot.get(key, 0),
374	        )
375	        return ordered_keys[:batch_size], partition_snapshot, prompt_global_steps_snapshot

377	    def _materialize_batch(
378	        self, partition_id: str, selected_prompt_uids: list[str], partition_snapshot: dict[str, dict]
379	    ) -> KVBatchMeta:
380	        tq.kv_clear(partition_id=partition_id, keys=selected_prompt_uids)
381	
382	        keys, tags = [], []
383	        selected = set(selected_prompt_uids)
384	        for key, tag in partition_snapshot.items():
385	            uid = key.split("_")[0]
386	            if uid in selected:
387	                keys.append(key)
388	                tags.append(tag)
389	        return KVBatchMeta(partition_id=partition_id, keys=keys, tags=tags)

391	    def _wait_for_next_poll(self, partition_id: str, last_debug_time: float) -> float:
392	        time.sleep(self.poll_interval)
393	        now = time.time()
394	        if now - last_debug_time > VERL_REPLAY_BUFFER_DEBUG_INTERVAL_SECONDS:
395	            logger.info(
396	                f"pending: {len(self.pending_keys[partition_id])}, "
397	                f"running: {len(self.running_keys[partition_id])}, "
398	                f"finished: {len(self.finished_keys[partition_id])}, "
399	                f"failure: {len(self.failure_keys[partition_id])}"
400	            )
401	            return now
402	        return last_debug_time

404	    @SkipManager.annotate_tq(role="rollout_tq", phase="sample")
405	    def sample(self, global_steps: int, partition_id: str, batch_size: int) -> tuple[KVBatchMeta, dict]:
406	        """Sample a batch using synchronous rollout semantics.
407	
408	        NOTE: user can customize sampling strategy by setting:
409	        ```bash
410	        trainer.v1.sampler.custom_sampler.path = "path/to/your/sampler.py"
411	        trainer.v1.sampler.custom_sampler.name = "UserCustomReplayBuffer"
412	        ```
413	
414	        Args:
415	            global_steps (int): Global steps of the current training.
416	            partition_id (str): Partition of TransferQueue, e.g. "train" or "val".
417	            batch_size (int, optional): Batch size.
418	
419	        Returns:
420	            KVBatchMeta: A batch of data.
421	            dict: Auxiliary metrics.
422	        """
423	        last_debug_time = time.time()
424	        eviction_metrics: dict = {}
425	        dapo_enabled = partition_id != "val" and self.filter_groups_metric is not None
426	        refill_credit = 0
427	        draining = False
428	        max_inflight_prompts = 0
429	        if dapo_enabled:
430	            max_inflight_prompts = self.max_inflight_gen_batches * self.train_batch_size
431	
432	        while True:
433	            # Eviction, gating, and selection below must all use this snapshot.
434	            self._sync_metadata_from_transfer_queue()
435	
436	            eviction_reasons = self._terminal_eviction_reasons(global_steps, partition_id)
437	            failed_count = len(eviction_reasons[2])
438	            evicted_uids, stale_count, dapo_count, metrics = self._evict_terminal_groups(
439	                global_steps, partition_id, eviction_reasons
440	            )
441	            if evicted_uids:
442	                _accumulate_eviction_metrics(eviction_metrics, metrics, stale_count)
443	
444	            sampleable_keys = self._sampleable_terminal_keys(partition_id, eviction_reasons)
445	            has_enough_samples = len(sampleable_keys) >= batch_size
446	            inflight_count = len(self.pending_keys[partition_id]) + len(self.running_keys[partition_id])
447	
448	            if not dapo_enabled and failed_count > 0 and not has_enough_samples:
449	                self.refill_fn(failed_count)
450	                continue
451	
452	            if dapo_enabled:
453	                if has_enough_samples:
454	                    # Stop speculative dispatch, then drain requests already running under this policy version.
455	                    draining = True
456	                    refill_credit = 0
457	                elif not draining:
458	                    refill_credit += 2 * dapo_count + failed_count
459	
460	                if not draining and refill_credit > 0:
461	                    available_slots = max(0, max_inflight_prompts - inflight_count)
462	                    dispatch_count = min(refill_credit, available_slots)
463	                    assert self.gen_batch_size is not None
464	                    dispatch_count -= dispatch_count % self.gen_batch_size
465	                    if dispatch_count > 0:
466	                        assert self.refill_fn is not None
467	                        self.refill_fn(dispatch_count)
468	                        refill_credit -= dispatch_count
469	                        continue
470	
471	            can_select = has_enough_samples and (not dapo_enabled or inflight_count == 0)
472	            if can_select:
473	                selected_prompt_uids, partition_snapshot, _prompt_global_steps_snapshot = self._select_prompt_uids(
474	                    partition_id, sampleable_keys, batch_size
475	                )
476	
477	                # Sync remains bufferless: all speculative requests are drained, then surplus is discarded.
478	                if dapo_enabled:
479	                    surplus_uids = sampleable_keys - set(selected_prompt_uids)
480	                    if surplus_uids:
481	                        self._clear_groups(partition_id, surplus_uids)
482	                        key = f"{self._metrics_prefix(partition_id)}/filter_groups/discarded_surplus_samples"
483	                        eviction_metrics[key] = eviction_metrics.get(key, 0) + len(surplus_uids)
484	                break
485	
486	            last_debug_time = self._wait_for_next_poll(partition_id, last_debug_time)
487	
488	        selected_uids = set(selected_prompt_uids)
489	        if partition_id != "val" and not any(key.split("_")[0] in selected_uids for key in partition_snapshot):
490	            message = "Sync replay buffer selected terminal groups with no materializable trajectories."
491	            if not self.sync_refill_failed_groups:
492	                message += " Enable trainer.v1.sampler.sync_refill_failed_groups to replace failed groups."
493	            raise RuntimeError(message)
494	        return self._materialize_batch(partition_id, selected_prompt_uids, partition_snapshot), eviction_metrics

elif key.endswith(\"/evicted_samples_staleness/min\"):\n            acc[key] = min(acc.get(key, value), value)\n        elif key == DAPO_FILTERED_REWARD_COUNTS_KEY:\n            # Dict-valued diagnostic: merge {metric_value: count} across poll iterations.\n            merged = Counter(acc.get(key, {}))\n            merged.update(value)\n            acc[key] = dict(merged)\n        else:\n            acc[key] = acc.get(key, 0) + value\n\n\n# TODO: Pass custom sampler to TransferQueue:\n# https://github.com/Ascend/TransferQueue/blob/main/tutorial/05_custom_sampler.py\n\n\nclass ReplayBuffer:\n    \"\"\"ReplayBuffer is used by trainer to sample trajectories produced during rollout.\n\n    We use [TransferQueue](https://github.com/Ascend/TransferQueue) as kv store to store trajectories.\n\n    ### [Trajectories storage format]\n    The key format is `{uid}_{session_id}_{index}`, where:\n    - uid: Auto generated unique id when prompt is sampled from dataset.\n    - session_id: Session id for GRPO group sampling: [0, n).\n    - index: Index of output trajectory in a session.\n\n    There're two types of data associated with each key: tag and value. The tag are arbitrary metadata:\n    `{\"status\": \"running\", ...}` used to track the status of the trajectory.\n\n    The value is a dictionary containing the following fields:\n    - messages/datasource/reward_model/...: fields from dataset.\n    - prompt_ids/response_ids/response_mask/...: fields from AgentLoopOutput.\n\n    TransferQueue store tag and value separately, the tag are stored in meta server, while the value is stored\n    in storage units.\n\n    ### [GRPO group sampling control]\n    Except trajectories, we also store raw prompts in TransferQueue with key `{uid}`, with `status` tag to track\n    status of GRPO group sampling.\n    - pending: the prompt is sampled from dataset but its sessions are not yet started.\n    - running: all sessions of the prompt are running.\n    - finished: all sessions of the prompt are finished without error.\n    - failure: all sessions of the prompt are finished, but at least one session failed.\n    Only prompts with status `finished` or `failure` enter terminal-group handling.\n\n    ### [Terminal-group eviction/refill matrix]\n    ``drop`` means off-policy staleness dropping. Both off-policy strategies (``drop`` and the dropless\n    ``wait``, which blocks until stale in-flight prompts finish) are only for async trainers; sync sampling\n    is on-policy, so ``max_off_policy_strategy`` is a NO-OP there.\n    ``DAPO`` means filtering groups whose configured reward metric is identical across all trajectories,\n             for async reward-computation path.\n    ``failure`` is the group status described above.\n    The matrix applies to the training partition, in which ``k`` is the number of prompts to evict.\n    Validation treats all terminal groups as sampleable\n\n    |   trainer mode   |   drop   |               DAPO               |            failure            |\n    | ---------------- | -------- | -------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |\n    |       sync       |   NO-OP  |    Evict ``k``; refill ``2k``    |  NO-OP or opt-in refill ``k`` |\n    |      async       |              All the same: Evict ``k``; refill ``k``.                       |\n\n    In sync mode, DAPO is opt-in and trades generation time for training stability. Each ``k`` evictions add\n    ``2k`` logical refill credits, but prompts are fetched only as bounded pending/running slots become available.\n    Terminal groups are filtered while other requests remain in flight. Once enough groups are sampleable, inflight\n    requests are drained and discarded. By default, failed groups remain sampleable and missing trajectories are\n    padded downstream. Setting ``sync_refill_failed_groups=True`` allows refilling failed samples.\n    In async mode, ``num_warmup_batches`` absorbs retry cost, so all three paths refill exactly ``k`` prompts.\n\n    Args:\n        trainer_mode (str): Trainer mode.\n        trainer_config (DictConfig): Trainer configuration.\n        max_off_policy_threshold (int): Maximum number of model versions that trajectory can span.\n        max_off_policy_strategy (str): How to handle trajectory that exceeds the maximum number of model versions.\n        sampler_kwargs (dict): Additional kwargs for the custom sampler.\n        poll_interval (float, optional): Poll interval in seconds. Defaults to 2.0.\n        refill_fn (callable, optional): Trainer-injected function that submits an exact number of fresh prompts.\n        filter_groups_metric (str, optional): DAPO group-filtering metric read from each trajectory's\n            ``extra_fields.reward_extra_info``. ``None`` disables DAPO filtering.\n        train_batch_size (int, optional): Prompt count represented by one Sync DAPO in-flight batch.\n        gen_batch_size (int, optional): Dataloader fetch granularity for refill dispatches.\n        max_inflight_gen_batches (int): Maximum Sync DAPO prompt batches concurrently pending or running.\n        sync_refill_failed_groups (bool): Whether sync sampling replaces failed groups with no trajectories.\n    \"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(\n        self,\n        trainer_mode: str,\n        trainer_config: DictConfig,\n        max_off_policy_threshold: int,\n        max_off_policy_strategy: str,\n        sampler_kwargs: DictConfig,\n        poll_interval: float = 2.0,\n        refill_fn=None,\n        filter_groups_metric: str | None = None,\n        train_batch_size: int | None = None,\n        gen_batch_size: int | None = None,\n        max_inflight_gen_batches: int = 1,\n        sync_refill_failed_groups: bool = False,\n    ):\n        self.trainer_mode = trainer_mode\n        self.trainer_config = trainer_config\n        self.max_off_policy_threshold = max_off_policy_threshold\n        self.max_off_policy_strategy = max_off_policy_strategy\n        self.sampler_kwargs = sampler_kwargs\n        self.poll_interval = poll_interval\n        self.refill_fn = refill_fn\n        self.filter_groups_metric = filter_groups_metric\n        self.train_batch_size = train_batch_size\n        self.gen_batch_size = gen_batch_size\n        self.max_inflight_gen_batches = max_inflight_gen_batches\n        self.sync_refill_failed_groups = sync_refill_failed_groups\n\n        assert isinstance(self.max_off_policy_threshold, int) and self.max_off_policy_threshold > 0, (\n            f\"Invalid max off policy threshold: {self.max_off_policy_threshold}, must be an integer greater than 0\"\n        )\n        assert self.max_off_policy_strategy in [\"drop\", \"wait\"], (\n            f\"Invalid max off policy strategy: {self.max_off_policy_strategy}, must be one of ['drop', 'wait']\"\n        )\n        if self.filter_groups_metric is not None and self.refill_fn is None:\n            raise ValueError(\"Group filtering (filter_groups_metric) requires refill_fn to replace evicted groups\")\n        if self.sync_refill_failed_groups and self.refill_fn is None:\n            raise ValueError(\"sync_refill_failed_groups requires refill_fn to replace failed groups\")\n        self._validate_mode_config()\n        # partition_id => {key: tag}\n        self.partitions: dict[str, dict[str, dict]] = defaultdict(dict)\n        self.pending_keys: dict[str, set] = defaultdict(set)\n        self.running_keys: dict[str, set] = defaultdict(set)\n        self.finished_keys: dict[str, set] = defaultdict(set)\n        self.failure_keys: dict[str, set] = defaultdict(set)\n        # partition_id => {prompt_key: global_steps}, used to prioritize older samples.\n        self.prompt_global_steps: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = defaultdict(dict)\n        # Finished groups are immutable, so their DAPO classification can be reused across polling iterations.\n        self._dapo_classification_cache: dict[str, dict[str, float | None]] = defaultdict(dict)\n\n    def _validate_mode_config(self) -> None:\n        if self.filter_groups_metric is not None:\n            if not isinstance(self.max_inflight_gen_batches, int) or self.max_inflight_gen_batches <= 0:\n                raise ValueError(\"max_inflight_gen_batches must be a positive integer\")\n        if self.sync_refill_failed_groups and self.gen_batch_size != 1:\n            raise ValueError(\"sync_refill_failed_groups requires gen_batch_size=1\")\n\n    def _sync_metadata_from_transfer_queue(self):\n        \"\"\"Sync the metadata from TransferQueue.\"\"\"\n        self.partitions.clear()\n        self.pending_keys.clear()\n        self.running_keys.clear()\n        self.finished_keys.clear()\n        self.failure_keys.clear()\n        self.prompt_global_steps.clear()\n\n        data = tq.kv_list()\n        if data is None:\n            return\n\n        for partition_id, items in data.items():\n            partition = self.partitions[partition_id]\n            for key, tag in items.items():\n                if tag.get(\"is_prompt\", False):\n                    # see: [GRPO group sampling control]\n                    self.prompt_global_steps[partition_id][key] = tag[\"global_steps\"]\n                    match tag[\"status\"]:\n                        case \"pending\":\n                            self.pending_keys[partition_id].add(key)\n                        case \"running\":\n                            self.running_keys[partition_id].add(key)\n                        case \"finished\":\n                            self.finished_keys[partition_id].add(key)\n                        case \"failure\":\n                            self.failure_keys[partition_id].add(key)\n                        case _:\n                            raise ValueError(f\"Unknown status: {tag['status']}\")\n                else:\n                    # see: [Trajectories storage format]\n                    if key not in partition:\n                        partition[key] = {}\n                    partition[key].update(tag)\n\n    @staticmethod\n    def _metrics_prefix(partition_id: str) -> str:\n        return \"training\" if partition_id == \"train\" else \"validation\"\n\n    def _clear_groups(self, partition_id: str, uids: set[str]) -> None:\n        \"\"\"Remove prompt groups from TransferQueue and the active metadata snapshot.\"\"\"\n        if not uids:\n            return\n\n        trajectory_keys = {key for key in self.partitions[partition_id] if key.split(\"_\")[0] in uids}\n        tq.kv_clear(\n            partition_id=partition_id,\n            keys=[*uids, *trajectory_keys],\n        )\n\n        # Keep same-poll decisions consistent with tq.\n        for key in trajectory_keys:\n            del self.partitions[partition_id][key]\n        for status_keys in (self.pending_keys, self.running_keys, self.finished_keys, self.failure_keys):\n            status_keys[partition_id].difference_update(uids)\n        for uid in uids:\n            self.prompt_global_steps[partition_id].pop(uid, None)\n            self._dapo_classification_cache[partition_id].pop(uid, None)\n\n    def _dapo_filtered_keys(self, partition_id: str) -> tuple[set[str], Counter]:\n        \"\"\"Finished groups whose configured DAPO metric is identical across all trajectories.\n\n        Returns the filtered uids and a ``{shared_metric_value: group_count}`` breakdown built in the\n        same scope, so the diagnostic (which reward level the no-signal groups collapse to) travels\n        with the uids through the return value instead of via hidden instance state.\n        \"\"\"\n        if partition_id == \"val\" or self.filter_groups_metric is None:\n            return set(), Counter()\n\n        finished_uids = self.finished_keys[partition_id]\n        classification_cache = self._dapo_classification_cache[partition_id]\n        for uid in classification_cache.keys() - finished_uids:\n            del classification_cache[uid]\n\n        new_finished_uids = finished_uids - classification_cache.keys()\n        trajectory_keys = [key for key in self.partitions[partition_id] if key.split(\"_\")[0] in new_finished_uids]\n        metrics_by_uid: dict[str, list[float]] = defaultdict(list)\n        missing_metric_uids = new_finished_uids - {key.split(\"_\")[0] for key in trajectory_keys}\n\n        if trajectory_keys:\n            data = tq.kv_batch_get(\n                keys=trajectory_keys,\n                partition_id=partition_id,\n                select_fields=[\"extra_fields\"],\n            )\n            extra_fields_list = list(data[\"extra_fields\"])\n        else:\n            extra_fields_list = []\n\n        for key, extra_fields in zip(trajectory_keys, extra_fields_list, strict=True):\n            uid = key.split(\"_\")[0]\n            extra_fields = getattr(extra_fields, \"data\", extra_fields)\n            reward_extra_info = extra_fields.get(\"reward_extra_info\", {}) if isinstance(extra_fields, dict) else {}\n            if self.filter_groups_metric not in reward_extra_info:\n                missing_metric_uids.add(uid)\n            else:\n                metrics_by_uid[uid].append(float(reward_extra_info[self.filter_groups_metric]))\n\n        if missing_metric_uids:\n            raise RuntimeError(\n                f\"Finished groups are missing DAPO metric {self.filter_groups_metric!r}: \"\n                f\"{sorted(missing_metric_uids)[:5]}\"\n            )\n\n        for uid in new_finished_uids:\n            values = metrics_by_uid[uid]\n            classification_cache[uid] = float(values[0]) if len(values) > 1 and float(np.std(values)) == 0.0 else None\n\n        filtered_rewards = {uid: reward for uid, reward in classification_cache.items() if reward is not None}\n        return set(filtered_rewards), Counter(filtered_rewards.values())\n\n    def _terminal_eviction_reasons(\n        self, global_steps: int, partition_id: str\n    ) -> tuple[set[str], set[str], set[str], Counter]:\n        \"\"\"Return stale, DAPO-filtered, and failed groups (plus the DAPO value->count breakdown).\n\n        The three sets may overlap. Callers clear and refill their union, so one prompt is never handled\n        twice. ``dapo_counts`` is the {shared_metric_value: group_count} diagnostic for ``dapo_uids``; it\n        rides along in the return value so no hidden state is needed between production and consumption.\n        \"\"\"\n        if partition_id == \"val\":\n            return set(), set(), set(), Counter()\n\n        dapo_uids, dapo_counts = self._dapo_filtered_keys(partition_id)\n        failed_uids = set()\n        if self.sync_refill_failed_groups:\n            materializable_uids = {key.split(\"_\")[0] for key in self.partitions[partition_id]}\n            failed_uids = self.failure_keys[partition_id] - materializable_uids\n        return set(), dapo_uids, failed_uids, dapo_counts\n\n    def _sampleable_terminal_keys(\n        self,\n        partition_id: str,\n        eviction_reasons: tuple[set[str], set[str], set[str], Counter],\n    ) -> set[str]:\n        terminal_uids = self.finished_keys[partition_id] | self.failure_keys[partition_id]\n        stale_uids, dapo_uids, failed_uids, _dapo_counts = eviction_reasons\n        return terminal_uids - (stale_uids | dapo_uids | failed_uids)\n\n    def _evict_terminal_groups(\n        self,\n        global_steps: int,\n        partition_id: str,\n        eviction_reasons: tuple[set[str], set[str], set[str], Counter],\n    ) -> tuple[set[str], int, int, dict]:\n        \"\"\"Evict terminal groups selected by any active policy exactly once.\"\"\"\n        stale_uids, dapo_uids, failed_uids, dapo_counts = eviction_reasons\n        evicted_uids = stale_uids | dapo_uids | failed_uids\n        if not evicted_uids:\n            return set(), 0, 0, {}\n\n        prefix = self._metrics_prefix(partition_id)\n        metrics: dict = {}\n        if stale_uids:\n            prompt_global_steps = self.prompt_global_steps[partition_id]\n            spans = np.array(\n                [global_steps - prompt_global_steps.get(uid, global_steps) + 1 for uid in stale_uids],\n                dtype=float,\n            )\n            metrics.update(\n                {\n                    f\"{prefix}/off_policy/evicted_samples\": len(stale_uids),\n                    f\"{prefix}/off_policy/evicted_samples_staleness/mean\": spans.mean(),\n                    f\"{prefix}/off_policy/evicted_samples_staleness/max\": spans.max(),\n                    f\"{prefix}/off_policy/evicted_samples_staleness/min\": spans.min(),\n                }\n            )\n        if dapo_uids:\n            metrics[f\"{prefix}/filter_groups/evicted_samples\"] = len(dapo_uids)\n            # Non-scalar diagnostic: how many filtered (no-signal) groups collapsed to each metric value.\n            metrics[DAPO_FILTERED_REWARD_COUNTS_KEY] = dict(dapo_counts)\n        if failed_uids:\n            metrics[f\"{prefix}/rollout_failure/evicted_samples\"] = len(failed_uids)\n\n        self._clear_groups(partition_id, evicted_uids)\n        return evicted_uids, len(stale_uids), len(dapo_uids), metrics\n\n    def _select_prompt_uids(\n        self, partition_id: str, sampleable_keys: set[str], batch_size: int\n    ) -> tuple[list[str], dict[str, dict], dict[str, int]]:\n        prompt_global_steps_snapshot = dict(self.prompt_global_steps[partition_id])\n        partition_snapshot = dict(self.partitions[partition_id])\n        ordered_keys = sorted(\n            sampleable_keys,\n            key=lambda key: prompt_global_steps_snapshot.get(key, 0),\n        )\n        return ordered_keys[:batch_size], partition_snapshot, prompt_global_steps_snapshot\n\n    def _materialize_batch(\n        self, partition_id: str, selected_prompt_uids: list[str], partition_snapshot: dict[str, dict]\n    ) -> KVBatchMeta:\n        tq.kv_clear(partition_id=partition_id, keys=selected_prompt_uids)\n\n        keys, tags = [], []\n        selected = set(selected_prompt_uids)\n        for key, tag in partition_snapshot.items():\n            uid = key.split(\"_\")[0]\n            if uid in selected:\n                keys.append(key)\n                tags.append(tag)\n        return KVBatchMeta(partition_id=partition_id, keys=keys, tags=tags)\n\n    def _wait_for_next_poll(self, partition_id: str, last_debug_time: float) -> float:\n        time.sleep(self.poll_interval)\n        now = time.time()\n        if now - last_debug_time > VERL_REPLAY_BUFFER_DEBUG_INTERVAL_SECONDS:\n            logger.info(\n                f\"pending: {len(self.pending_keys[partition_id])}, \"\n                f\"running: {len(self.running_keys[partition_id])}, \"\n                f\"finished: {len(self.finished_keys[partition_id])}, \"\n                f\"failure: {len(self.failure_keys[partition_id])}\"\n            )\n            return now\n        return last_debug_time\n\n    @SkipManager.annotate_tq(role=\"rollout_tq\", phase=\"sample\")\n    def sample(self, global_steps: int, partition_id: str, batch_size: int) -> tuple[KVBatchMeta, dict]:\n        \"\"\"Sample a batch using synchronous rollout semantics.\n\n        NOTE: user can customize sampling strategy by setting:\n        ```bash\n        trainer.v1.sampler.custom_sampler.path = \"path/to/your/sampler.py\"\n        trainer.v1.sampler.custom_sampler.name = \"UserCustomReplayBuffer\"\n        ```\n\n        Args:\n            global_steps (int): Global steps of the current training.\n            partition_id (str): Partition of TransferQueue, e.g. \"train\" or \"val\".\n            batch_size (int, optional): Batch size.\n\n        Returns:\n            KVBatchMeta: A batch of data.\n            dict: Auxiliary metrics.\n        \"\"\"\n        last_debug_time = time.time()\n        eviction_metrics: dict = {}\n        dapo_enabled = partition_id != \"val\" and self.filter_groups_metric is not None\n        refill_credit = 0\n        draining = False\n        max_inflight_prompts = 0\n        if dapo_enabled:\n            max_inflight_prompts = self.max_inflight_gen_batches * self.train_batch_size\n\n        while True:\n            # Eviction, gating, and selection below must all use this snapshot.\n            self._sync_metadata_from_transfer_queue()\n\n            eviction_reasons = self._terminal_eviction_reasons(global_steps, partition_id)\n            failed_count = len(eviction_reasons[2])\n            evicted_uids, stale_count, dapo_count, metrics = self._evict_terminal_groups(\n                global_steps, partition_id, eviction_reasons\n            )\n            if evicted_uids:\n                _accumulate_eviction_metrics(eviction_metrics, metrics, stale_count)\n\n            sampleable_keys = self._sampleable_terminal_keys(partition_id, eviction_reasons)\n            has_enough_samples = len(sampleable_keys) >= batch_size\n            inflight_count = len(self.pending_keys[partition_id]) + len(self.running_keys[partition_id])\n\n            if not dapo_enabled and failed_count > 0 and not has_enough_samples:\n                self.refill_fn(failed_count)\n                continue\n\n            if dapo_enabled:\n                if has_enough_samples:\n                    # Stop speculative dispatch, then drain requests already running under this policy version.\n                    draining = True\n                    refill_credit = 0\n                elif not draining:\n                    refill_credit += 2 * dapo_count + failed_count\n\n                if not draining and refill_credit > 0:\n                    available_slots = max(0, max_inflight_prompts - inflight_count)\n                    dispatch_count = min(refill_credit, available_slots)\n                    assert self.gen_batch_size is not None\n                    dispatch_count -= dispatch_count % self.gen_batch_size\n                    if dispatch_count > 0:\n                        assert self.refill_fn is not None\n                        self.refill_fn(dispatch_count)\n                        refill_credit -= dispatch_count\n                        continue\n\n            can_select = has_enough_samples and (not dapo_enabled or inflight_count == 0)\n            if can_select:\n                selected_prompt_uids, partition_snapshot, _prompt_global_steps_snapshot = self._select_prompt_uids(\n                    partition_id, sampleable_keys, batch_size\n                )\n\n                # Sync remains bufferless: all speculative requests are drained, then surplus is discarded.\n                if dapo_enabled:\n                    surplus_uids = sampleable_keys - set(selected_prompt_uids)\n                    if surplus_uids:\n                        self._clear_groups(partition_id, surplus_uids)\n                        key = f\"{self._metrics_prefix(partition_id)}/filter_groups/discarded_surplus_samples\"\n                        eviction_metrics[key] = eviction_metrics.get(key, 0) + len(surplus_uids)\n                break\n\n            last_debug_time = self._wait_for_next_poll(partition_id, last_debug_time)\n\n        selected_uids = set(selected_prompt_uids)\n        if partition_id != \"val\" and not import logging
import os
import time
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

import numpy as np
import transfer_queue as tq
from omegaconf import DictConfig
from transfer_queue import KVBatchMeta

from verl.utils.skip import SkipManager

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
logger.setLevel(os.getenv("VERL_LOGGING_LEVEL", "INFO"))

VERL_REPLAY_BUFFER_DEBUG_INTERVAL_SECONDS = int(os.getenv("VERL_REPLAY_BUFFER_DEBUG_INTERVAL_SECONDS", "60"))

DAPO_FILTERED_REWARD_COUNTS_KEY = "_dapo_filtered_reward_counts"


def _accumulate_eviction_metrics(acc: dict, new: dict, stale_count: int) -> None:
    """Merge one poll iteration's eviction metrics into ``acc`` in place.

    ``stale_count`` weights the staleness mean so it stays a true per-sample average across iterations.
    """
    stale_count_key = next((k for k in new if k.endswith("/off_policy/evicted_samples")), None)
    prev_stale_total = acc.get(stale_count_key, 0) if stale_count_key else 0

    for key, value in new.items():
        if key.endswith("/evicted_samples_staleness/mean"):
            denom = prev_stale_total + stale_count
            acc[key] = (acc.get(key, 0.0) * prev_stale_total + value * stale_count) / denom if denom else value
        elif key.endswith("/evicted_samples_staleness/max"):
            acc[key] = max(acc.get(key, value), value)
        elif key.endswith("/evicted_samples_staleness/min"):
            acc[key] = min(acc.get(key, value), value)
        elif key == DAPO_FILTERED_REWARD_COUNTS_KEY:
            # Dict-valued diagnostic: merge {metric_value: count} across poll iterations.
            merged = Counter(acc.get(key, {}))
            merged.update(value)
            acc[key] = dict(merged)
        else:
            acc[key] = acc.get(key, 0) + value

class ReplayBuffer:
    """ReplayBuffer is used by trainer to sample trajectories produced during rollout.

    We use [TransferQueue](https://github.com/Ascend/TransferQueue) as kv store to store trajectories.

    ### [Trajectories storage format]
    The key format is `{uid}_{session_id}_{index}`, where:
    - uid: Auto generated unique id when prompt is sampled from dataset.
    - session_id: Session id for GRPO group sampling: [0, n).
    - index: Index of output trajectory in a session.

    There're two types of data associated with each key: tag and value. The tag are arbitrary metadata:
    `{"status": "running", ...}` used to track the status of the trajectory.

    The value is a dictionary containing the following fields:
    - messages/datasource/reward_model/...: fields from dataset.
    - prompt_ids/response_ids/response_mask/...: fields from AgentLoopOutput.

    TransferQueue store tag and value separately, the tag are stored in meta server, while the value is stored
    in storage units.

    ### [GRPO group sampling control]
    Except trajectories, we also store raw prompts in TransferQueue with key `{uid}`, with `status` tag to track
    status of GRPO group sampling.
    - pending: the prompt is sampled from dataset but its sessions are not yet started.
    - running: all sessions of the prompt are running.
    - finished: all sessions of the prompt are finished without error.
    - failure: all sessions of the prompt are finished, but at least one session failed.
    Only prompts with status `finished` or `failure` enter terminal-group handling.

    ### [Terminal-group eviction/refill matrix]
    ``drop`` means off-policy staleness dropping. Both off-policy strategies (``drop`` and the dropless
    ``wait``, which blocks until stale in-flight prompts finish) are only for async trainers; sync sampling
    is on-policy, so ``max_off_policy_strategy`` is a NO-OP there.
    ``DAPO`` means filtering groups whose configured reward metric is identical across all trajectories,
             for async reward-computation path.
    ``failure`` is the group status described above.
    The matrix applies to the training partition, in which ``k`` is the number of prompts to evict.
    Validation treats all terminal groups as sampleable

    |   trainer mode   |   drop   |               DAPO               |            failure            |
    | ---------------- | -------- | -------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
    |       sync       |   NO-OP  |    Evict ``k``; refill ``2k``    |  NO-OP or opt-in refill ``k`` |
    |      async       |              All the same: Evict ``k``; refill ``k``.                       |

    In sync mode, DAPO is opt-in and trades generation time for training stability. Each ``k`` evictions add
    ``2k`` logical refill credits, but prompts are fetched only as bounded pending/running slots become available.
    Terminal groups are filtered while other requests remain in flight. Once enough groups are sampleable, inflight
    requests are drained and discarded. By default, failed groups remain sampleable and missing trajectories are
    padded downstream. Setting ``sync_refill_failed_groups=True`` allows refilling failed samples.
    In async mode, ``num_warmup_batches`` absorbs retry cost, so all three paths refill exactly ``k`` prompts.

    Args:
        trainer_mode (str): Trainer mode.
        trainer_config (DictConfig): Trainer configuration.
        max_off_policy_threshold (int): Maximum number of model versions that trajectory can span.
        max_off_policy_strategy (str): How to handle trajectory that exceeds the maximum number of model versions.
        sampler_kwargs (dict): Additional kwargs for the custom sampler.
        poll_interval (float, optional): Poll interval in seconds. Defaults to 2.0.
        refill_fn (callable, optional): Trainer-injected function that submits an exact number of fresh prompts.
        filter_groups_metric (str, optional): DAPO group-filtering metric read from each trajectory's
            ``extra_fields.reward_extra_info``. ``None`` disables DAPO filtering.
        train_batch_size (int, optional): Prompt count represented by one Sync DAPO in-flight batch.
        gen_batch_size (int, optional): Dataloader fetch granularity for refill dispatches.
        max_inflight_gen_batches (int): Maximum Sync DAPO prompt batches concurrently pending or running.
        sync_refill_failed_groups (bool): Whether sync sampling replaces failed groups with no trajectories.
    """

    def __init__(
        self,
        trainer_mode: str,
        trainer_config: DictConfig,
        max_off_policy_threshold: int,
        max_off_policy_strategy: str,
        sampler_kwargs: DictConfig,
        poll_interval: float = 2.0,
        refill_fn=None,
        filter_groups_metric: str | None = None,
        train_batch_size: int | None = None,
        gen_batch_size: int | None = None,
        max_inflight_gen_batches: int = 1,
        sync_refill_failed_groups: bool = False,
    ):
        self.trainer_mode = trainer_mode
        self.trainer_config = trainer_config
        self.max_off_policy_threshold = max_off_policy_threshold
        self.max_off_policy_strategy = max_off_policy_strategy
        self.sampler_kwargs = sampler_kwargs
        self.poll_interval = poll_interval
        self.refill_fn = refill_fn
        self.filter_groups_metric = filter_groups_metric
        self.train_batch_size = train_batch_size
        self.gen_batch_size = gen_batch_size
        self.max_inflight_gen_batches = max_inflight_gen_batches
        self.sync_refill_failed_groups = sync_refill_failed_groups

        assert isinstance(self.max_off_policy_threshold, int) and self.max_off_policy_threshold > 0, (
            f"Invalid max off policy threshold: {self.max_off_policy_threshold}, must be an integer greater than 0"
        )
        assert self.max_off_policy_strategy in ["drop", "wait"], (
            f"Invalid max off policy strategy: {self.max_off_policy_strategy}, must be one of ['drop', 'wait']"
        )
        if self.filter_groups_metric is not None and self.refill_fn is None:
            raise ValueError("Group filtering (filter_groups_metric) requires refill_fn to replace evicted groups")
        if self.sync_refill_failed_groups and self.refill_fn is None:
            raise ValueError("sync_refill_failed_groups requires refill_fn to replace failed groups")
        self._validate_mode_config()
        # partition_id => {key: tag}
        self.partitions: dict[str, dict[str, dict]] = defaultdict(dict)
        self.pending_keys: dict[str, set] = defaultdict(set)
        self.running_keys: dict[str, set] = defaultdict(set)
        self.finished_keys: dict[str, set] = defaultdict(set)
        self.failure_keys: dict[str, set] = defaultdict(set)
        # partition_id => {prompt_key: global_steps}, used to prioritize older samples.
        self.prompt_global_steps: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = defaultdict(dict)
        # Finished groups are immutable, so their DAPO classification can be reused across polling iterations.
        self._dapo_classification_cache: dict[str, dict[str, float | None]] = defaultdict(dict)

    def _validate_mode_config(self) -> None:
        if self.filter_groups_metric is not None:
            if not isinstance(self.max_inflight_gen_batches, int) or self.max_inflight_gen_batches <= 0:
                raise ValueError("max_inflight_gen_batches must be a positive integer")
        if self.sync_refill_failed_groups and self.gen_batch_size != 1:
            raise ValueError("sync_refill_failed_groups requires gen_batch_size=1")

    def _sync_metadata_from_transfer_queue(self):
        """Sync the metadata from TransferQueue."""
        self.partitions.clear()
        self.pending_keys.clear()
        self.running_keys.clear()
        self.finished_keys.clear()
        self.failure_keys.clear()
        self.prompt_global_steps.clear()

        data = tq.kv_list()
        if data is None:
            return

        for partition_id, items in data.items():
            partition = self.partitions[partition_id]
            for key, tag in items.items():
                if tag.get("is_prompt", False):
                    # see: [GRPO group sampling control]
                    self.prompt_global_steps[partition_id][key] = tag["global_steps"]
                    match tag["status"]:
                        case "pending":
                            self.pending_keys[partition_id].add(key)
                        case "running":
                            self.running_keys[partition_id].add(key)
                        case "finished":
                            self.finished_keys[partition_id].add(key)
                        case "failure":
                            self.failure_keys[partition_id].add(key)
                        case _:
                            raise ValueError(f"Unknown status: {tag['status']}")
                else:
                    # see: [Trajectories storage format]
                    if key not in partition:
                        partition[key] = {}
                    partition[key].update(tag)

    @staticmethod
    def _metrics_prefix(partition_id: str) -> str:
        return "training" if partition_id == "train" else "validation"

    def _clear_groups(self, partition_id: str, uids: set[str]) -> None:
        """Remove prompt groups from TransferQueue and the active metadata snapshot."""
        if not uids:
            return

        trajectory_keys = {key for key in self.partitions[partition_id] if key.split("_")[0] in uids}
        tq.kv_clear(
            partition_id=partition_id,
            keys=[*uids, *trajectory_keys],
        )

        # Keep same-poll decisions consistent with tq.
        for key in trajectory_keys:
            del self.partitions[partition_id][key]
        for status_keys in (self.pending_keys, self.running_keys, self.finished_keys, self.failure_keys):
            status_keys[partition_id].difference_update(uids)
        for uid in uids:
            self.prompt_global_steps[partition_id].pop(uid, None)
            self._dapo_classification_cache[partition_id].pop(uid, None)

    def _dapo_filtered_keys(self, partition_id: str) -> tuple[set[str], Counter]:
        """Finished groups whose configured DAPO metric is identical across all trajectories.

        Returns the filtered uids and a ``{shared_metric_value: group_count}`` breakdown built in the
        same scope, so the diagnostic (which reward level the no-signal groups collapse to) travels
        with the uids through the return value instead of via hidden instance state.
        """
        if partition_id == "val" or self.filter_groups_metric is None:
            return set(), Counter()

        finished_uids = self.finished_keys[partition_id]
        classification_cache = self._dapo_classification_cache[partition_id]
        for uid in classification_cache.keys() - finished_uids:
            del classification_cache[uid]

        new_finished_uids = finished_uids - classification_cache.keys()
        trajectory_keys = [key for key in self.partitions[partition_id] if key.split("_")[0] in new_finished_uids]
        metrics_by_uid: dict[str, list[float]] = defaultdict(list)
        missing_metric_uids = new_finished_uids - {key.split("_")[0] for key in trajectory_keys}

        if trajectory_keys:
            data = tq.kv_batch_get(
                keys=trajectory_keys,
                partition_id=partition_id,
                select_fields=["extra_fields"],
            )
            extra_fields_list = list(data["extra_fields"])
        else:
            extra_fields_list = []

        for key, extra_fields in zip(trajectory_keys, extra_fields_list, strict=True):
            uid = key.split("_")[0]
            extra_fields = getattr(extra_fields, "data", extra_fields)
            reward_extra_info = extra_fields.get("reward_extra_info", {}) if isinstance(extra_fields, dict) else {}
            if self.filter_groups_metric not in reward_extra_info:
                missing_metric_uids.add(uid)
            else:
                metrics_by_uid[uid].append(float(reward_extra_info[self.filter_groups_metric]))

        if missing_metric_uids:
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"Finished groups are missing DAPO metric {self.filter_groups_metric!r}: "
                f"{sorted(missing_metric_uids)[:5]}"
            )

        for uid in new_finished_uids:
            values = metrics_by_uid[uid]
            classification_cache[uid] = float(values[0]) if len(values) > 1 and float(np.std(values)) == 0.0 else None

        filtered_rewards = {uid: reward for uid, reward in classification_cache.items() if reward is not None}
        return set(filtered_rewards), Counter(filtered_rewards.values())

    def _terminal_eviction_reasons(
        self, global_steps: int, partition_id: str
    ) -> tuple[set[str], set[str], set[str], Counter]:
        """Return stale, DAPO-filtered, and failed groups (plus the DAPO value->count breakdown).

        The three sets may overlap. Callers clear and refill their union, so one prompt is never handled
        twice. ``dapo_counts`` is the {shared_metric_value: group_count} diagnostic for ``dapo_uids``; it
        rides along in the return value so no hidden state is needed between production and consumption.
        """
        if partition_id == "val":
            return set(), set(), set(), Counter()

        dapo_uids, dapo_counts = self._dapo_filtered_keys(partition_id)
        failed_uids = set()
        if self.sync_refill_failed_groups:
            materializable_uids = {key.split("_")[0] for key in self.partitions[partition_id]}
            failed_uids = self.failure_keys[partition_id] - materializable_uids
        return set(), dapo_uids, failed_uids, dapo_counts

    def _sampleable_terminal_keys(
        self,
        partition_id: str,
        eviction_reasons: tuple[set[str], set[str], set[str], Counter],
    ) -> set[str]:
        terminal_uids = self.finished_keys[partition_id] | self.failure_keys[partition_id]
        stale_uids, dapo_uids, failed_uids, _dapo_counts = eviction_reasons
        return terminal_uids - (stale_uids | dapo_uids | failed_uids)

    def _evict_terminal_groups(
        self,
        global_steps: int,
        partition_id: str,
        eviction_reasons: tuple[set[str], set[str], set[str], Counter],
    ) -> tuple[set[str], int, int, dict]:
        """Evict terminal groups selected by any active policy exactly once."""
        stale_uids, dapo_uids, failed_uids, dapo_counts = eviction_reasons
        evicted_uids = stale_uids | dapo_uids | failed_uids
        if not evicted_uids:
            return set(), 0, 0, {}

        prefix = self._metrics_prefix(partition_id)
        metrics: dict = {}
        if stale_uids:
            prompt_global_steps = self.prompt_global_steps[partition_id]
            spans = np.array(
                [global_steps - prompt_global_steps.get(uid, global_steps) + 1 for uid in stale_uids],
                dtype=float,
            )
            metrics.update(
                {
                    f"{prefix}/off_policy/evicted_samples": len(stale_uids),
                    f"{prefix}/off_policy/evicted_samples_staleness/mean": spans.mean(),
                    f"{prefix}/off_policy/evicted_samples_staleness/max": spans.max(),
                    f"{prefix}/off_policy/evicted_samples_staleness/min": spans.min(),
                }
            )
        if dapo_uids:
            metrics[f"{prefix}/filter_groups/evicted_samples"] = len(dapo_uids)
            # Non-scalar diagnostic: how many filtered (no-signal) groups collapsed to each metric value.
            metrics[DAPO_FILTERED_REWARD_COUNTS_KEY] = dict(dapo_counts)
        if failed_uids:
            metrics[f"{prefix}/rollout_failure/evicted_samples"] = len(failed_uids)

        self._clear_groups(partition_id, evicted_uids)
        return evicted_uids, len(stale_uids), len(dapo_uids), metrics

    def _select_prompt_uids(
        self, partition_id: str, sampleable_keys: set[str], batch_size: int
    ) -> tuple[list[str], dict[str, dict], dict[str, int]]:
        prompt_global_steps_snapshot = dict(self.prompt_global_steps[partition_id])
        partition_snapshot = dict(self.partitions[partition_id])
        ordered_keys = sorted(
            sampleable_keys,
            key=lambda key: prompt_global_steps_snapshot.get(key, 0),
        )
        return ordered_keys[:batch_size], partition_snapshot, prompt_global_steps_snapshot

    def _materialize_batch(
        self, partition_id: str, selected_prompt_uids: list[str], partition_snapshot: dict[str, dict]
    ) -> KVBatchMeta:
        tq.kv_clear(partition_id=partition_id, keys=selected_prompt_uids)

        keys, tags = [], []
        selected = set(selected_prompt_uids)
        for key, tag in partition_snapshot.items():
            uid = key.split("_")[0]
            if uid in selected:
                keys.append(key)
                tags.append(tag)
        return KVBatchMeta(partition_id=partition_id, keys=keys, tags=tags)

    def _wait_for_next_poll(self, partition_id: str, last_debug_time: float) -> float:
        time.sleep(self.poll_interval)
        now = time.time()
        if now - last_debug_time > VERL_REPLAY_BUFFER_DEBUG_INTERVAL_SECONDS:
            logger.info(
                f"pending: {len(self.pending_keys[partition_id])}, "
                f"running: {len(self.running_keys[partition_id])}, "
                f"finished: {len(self.finished_keys[partition_id])}, "
                f"failure: {len(self.failure_keys[partition_id])}"
            )
            return now
        return last_debug_time

    @SkipManager.annotate_tq(role="rollout_tq", phase="sample")
    def sample(self, global_steps: int, partition_id: str, batch_size: int) -> tuple[KVBatchMeta, dict]:
        """Sample a batch using synchronous rollout semantics.

        NOTE: user can customize sampling strategy by setting:
        ```bash
        trainer.v1.sampler.custom_sampler.path = "path/to/your/sampler.py"
        trainer.v1.sampler.custom_sampler.name = "UserCustomReplayBuffer"
        ```

        Args:
            global_steps (int): Global steps of the current training.
            partition_id (str): Partition of TransferQueue, e.g. "train" or "val".
            batch_size (int, optional): Batch size.

        Returns:
            KVBatchMeta: A batch of data.
            dict: Auxiliary metrics.
        """
        last_debug_time = time.time()
        eviction_metrics: dict = {}
        dapo_enabled = partition_id != "val" and self.filter_groups_metric is not None
        refill_credit = 0
        draining = False
        max_inflight_prompts = 0
        if dapo_enabled:
            max_inflight_prompts = self.max_inflight_gen_batches * self.train_batch_size

        while True:
            # Eviction, gating, and selection below must all use this snapshot.
            self._sync_metadata_from_transfer_queue()

            eviction_reasons = self._terminal_eviction_reasons(global_steps, partition_id)
            failed_count = len(eviction_reasons[2])
            evicted_uids, stale_count, dapo_count, metrics = self._evict_terminal_groups(
                global_steps, partition_id, eviction_reasons
            )
            if evicted_uids:
                _accumulate_eviction_metrics(eviction_metrics, metrics, stale_count)

            sampleable_keys = self._sampleable_terminal_keys(partition_id, eviction_reasons)
            has_enough_samples = len(sampleable_keys) >= batch_size
            inflight_count = len(self.pending_keys[partition_id]) + len(self.running_keys[partition_id])

            if not dapo_enabled and failed_count > 0 and not has_enough_samples:
                self.refill_fn(failed_count)
                continue

            if dapo_enabled:
                if has_enough_samples:
                    # Stop speculative dispatch, then drain requests already running under this policy version.
                    draining = True
                    refill_credit = 0
                elif not draining:
                    refill_credit += 2 * dapo_count + failed_count

                if not draining and refill_credit > 0:
                    available_slots = max(0, max_inflight_prompts - inflight_count)
                    dispatch_count = min(refill_credit, available_slots)
                    assert self.gen_batch_size is not None
                    dispatch_count -= dispatch_count % self.gen_batch_size
                    if dispatch_count > 0:
                        assert self.refill_fn is not None
                        self.refill_fn(dispatch_count)
                        refill_credit -= dispatch_count
                        continue

            can_select = has_enough_samples and (not dapo_enabled or inflight_count == 0)
            if can_select:
                selected_prompt_uids, partition_snapshot, _prompt_global_steps_snapshot = self._select_prompt_uids(
                    partition_id, sampleable_keys, batch_size
                )

                # Sync remains bufferless: all speculative requests are drained, then surplus is discarded.
                if dapo_enabled:
                    surplus_uids = sampleable_keys - set(selected_prompt_uids)
                    if surplus_uids:
                        self._clear_groups(partition_id, surplus_uids)
                        key = f"{self._metrics_prefix(partition_id)}/filter_groups/discarded_surplus_samples"
                        eviction_metrics[key] = eviction_metrics.get(key, 0) + len(surplus_uids)
                break

            last_debug_time = self._wait_for_next_poll(partition_id, last_debug_time)

        selected_uids = set(selected_prompt_uids)
        if partition_id != "val" and not any(key.split("_")[0] in selected_uids for key in partition_snapshot):
            message = "Sync replay buffer selected terminal groups with no materializable trajectories."
            if not self.sync_refill_failed_groups:
                message += " Enable trainer.v1.sampler.sync_refill_failed_groups to replace failed groups."
            raise RuntimeError(message)
        return self._materialize_batch(partition_id, selected_prompt_uids, partition_snapshot), eviction_metrics
