93	    ### [Terminal-group eviction/refill matrix]
94	    ``drop`` means off-policy staleness dropping. Both off-policy strategies (``drop`` and the dropless
95	    ``wait``, which blocks until stale in-flight prompts finish) are only for async trainers; sync sampling
96	    is on-policy, so ``max_off_policy_strategy`` is a NO-OP there.
97	    ``DAPO`` means filtering groups whose configured reward metric is identical across all trajectories,
98	             for async reward-computation path.
99	    ``failure`` is the group status described above.
100	    The matrix applies to the training partition, in which ``k`` is the number of prompts to evict.
101	    Validation treats all terminal groups as sampleable
102	
103	    |   trainer mode   |   drop   |               DAPO               |            failure            |
104	    | ---------------- | -------- | -------------------------------- | ----------------------------- |
105	    |       sync       |   NO-OP  |    Evict ``k``; refill ``2k``    |  NO-OP or opt-in refill ``k`` |
106	    |      async       |              All the same: Evict ``k``; refill ``k``.                       |
107	
108	    In sync mode, DAPO is opt-in and trades generation time for training stability. Each ``k`` evictions add
109	    ``2k`` logical refill credits, but prompts are fetched only as bounded pending/running slots become available.
110	    Terminal groups are filtered while other requests remain in flight. Once enough groups are sampleable, inflight
111	    requests are drained and discarded. By default, failed groups remain sampleable and missing trajectories are
112	    padded downstream. Setting ``sync_refill_failed_groups=True`` allows refilling failed samples.
113	    In async mode, ``num_warmup_batches`` absorbs retry cost, so all three paths refill exactly ``k`` prompts.
114	
115	    Args:
116	        trainer_mode (str): Trainer mode.
117	        trainer_config (DictConfig): Trainer configuration.
118	        max_off_policy_threshold (int): Maximum number of model versions that trajectory can span.
119	        max_off_policy_strategy (str): How to handle trajectory that exceeds the maximum number of model versions.
120	        sampler_kwargs (dict): Additional kwargs for the custom sampler.
121	        poll_interval (float, optional): Poll interval in seconds. Defaults to 2.0.
122	        refill_fn (callable, optional): Trainer-injected function that submits an exact number of fresh prompts.
123	        filter_groups_metric (str, optional): DAPO group-filtering metric read from each trajectory's
124	            ``extra_fields.reward_extra_info``. ``None`` disables DAPO filtering.
125	        train_batch_size (int, optional): Prompt count represented by one Sync DAPO in-flight batch.
126	        gen_batch_size (int, optional): Dataloader fetch granularity for refill dispatches.
127	        max_inflight_gen_batches (int): Maximum Sync DAPO prompt batches concurrently pending or running.
128	        sync_refill_failed_groups (bool): Whether sync sampling replaces failed groups with no trajectories.
129	    """
130	
131	    def __init__(
132	        self,
133	        trainer_mode: str,
134	        trainer_config: DictConfig,
135	        max_off_policy_threshold: int,
136	        max_off_policy_strategy: str,
137	        sampler_kwargs: DictConfig,
138	        poll_interval: float = 2.0,
139	        refill_fn=None,
140	        filter_groups_metric: str | None = None,
141	        train_batch_size: int | None = None,
142	        gen_batch_size: int | None = None,
143	        max_inflight_gen_batches: int = 1,
144	        sync_refill_failed_groups: bool = False,
145	    ):
146	        self.trainer_mode = trainer_mode
147	        self.trainer_config = trainer_config
148	        self.max_off_policy_threshold = max_off_policy_threshold
149	        self.max_off_policy_strategy = max_off_policy_strategy
150	        self.sampler_kwargs = sampler_kwargs
151	        self.poll_interval = poll_interval
152	        self.refill_fn = refill_fn
153	        self.filter_groups_metric = filter_groups_metric
154	        self.train_batch_size = train_batch_size
155	        self.gen_batch_size = gen_batch_size
156	        self.max_inflight_gen_batches = max_inflight_gen_batches
157	        self.sync_refill_failed_groups = sync_refill_failed_groups
158	
159	        assert isinstance(self.max_off_policy_threshold, int) and self.max_off_policy_threshold > 0, (
160	            f"Invalid max off policy threshold: {self.max_off_policy_threshold}, must be an integer greater than 0"
161	        )
162	        assert self.max_off_policy_strategy in ["drop", "wait"], (
163	            f"Invalid max off policy strategy: {self.max_off_policy_strategy}, must be one of ['drop', 'wait']"
164	        )
165	        if self.filter_groups_metric is not None and self.refill_fn is None:
166	            raise ValueError("Group filtering (filter_groups_metric) requires refill_fn to replace evicted groups")
167	        if self.sync_refill_failed_groups and self.refill_fn is None:
168	            raise ValueError("sync_refill_failed_groups requires refill_fn to replace failed groups")
169	        self._validate_mode_config()
170	        # partition_id => {key: tag}
171	        self.partitions: dict[str, dict[str, dict]] = defaultdict(dict)
172	        self.pending_keys: dict[str, set] = defaultdict(set)
173	        self.running_keys: dict[str, set] = defaultdict(set)
174	        self.finished_keys: dict[str, set] = defaultdict(set)
175	        self.failure_keys: dict[str, set] = defaultdict(set)
176	        # partition_id => {prompt_key: global_steps}, used to prioritize older samples.
177	        self.prompt_global_steps: dict[str, dict[str, int]] = defaultdict(dict)
178	        # Finished groups are immutable, so their DAPO classification can be reused across polling iterations.
179	        self._dapo_classification_cache: dict[str, dict[str, float | None]] = defaultdict(dict)
180	
181	    def _validate_mode_config(self) -> None:
182	        if self.filter_groups_metric is not None:
183	            if not isinstance(self.max_inflight_gen_batches, int) or self.max_inflight_gen_batches <= 0:
184	                raise ValueError("max_inflight_gen_batches must be a positive integer")
185	        if self.sync_refill_failed_groups and self.gen_batch_size != 1:
186	            raise ValueError("sync_refill_failed_groups requires gen_batch_size=1")
187	
188	    def _sync_metadata_from_transfer_queue(self):
189	        """Sync the metadata from TransferQueue."""
190	        self.partitions.clear()
191	        self.pending_keys.clear()
192	        self.running_keys.clear()
193	        self.finished_keys.clear()
194	        self.failure_keys.clear()
195	        self.prompt_global_steps.clear()
196	
197	        data = tq.kv_list()
198	        if data is None:
199	            return
200	
201	        for partition_id, items in data.items():
202	            partition = self.partitions[partition_id]
203	            for key, tag in items.items():
204	                if tag.get("is_prompt", False):
205	                    # see: [GRPO group sampling control]
206	                    self.prompt_global_steps[partition_id][key] = tag["global_steps"]
207	                    match tag["status"]:
208	                        case "pending":
209	                            self.pending_keys[partition_id].add(key)
210	                        case "running":
211	                            self.running_keys[partition_id].add(key)
212	                        case "finished":
213	                            self.finished_keys[partition_id].add(key)
214	                        case "failure":
215	                            self.failure_keys[partition_id].add(key)
216	                        case _:
217	                            raise ValueError(f"Unknown status: {tag['status']}")
218	                else:
219	                    # see: [Trajectories storage format]
220	                    if key not in partition:
221	                        partition[key] = {}
222	                    partition[key].update(tag)
223	
224	    @staticmethod
225	    def _metrics_prefix(partition_id: str) -> str:
226	        return "training" if partition_id == "train" else "validation"
227	
228	    def _clear_groups(self, partition_id: str, uids: set[str]) -> None:
229	        """Remove prompt groups from TransferQueue and the active metadata snapshot."""
230	        if not uids:
231	            return
232	
233	        trajectory_keys = {key for key in self.partitions[partition_id] if key.split("_")[0] in uids}
234	        tq.kv_clear(
235	            partition_id=partition_id,
236	            keys=[*uids, *trajectory_keys],
237	        )
238	
239	        # Keep same-poll decisions consistent with tq.
240	        for key in trajectory_keys:
241	            del self.partitions[partition_id][key]
242	        for status_keys in (self.pending_keys, self.running_keys, self.finished_keys, self.failure_keys):
243	            status_keys[partition_id].difference_update(uids)
244	        for uid in uids:
245	            self.prompt_global_steps[partition_id].pop(uid, None)
246	            self._dapo_classification_cache[partition_id].pop(uid, None)
247	
248	    def _dapo_filtered_keys(self, partition_id: str) -> tuple[set[str], Counter]:
249	        """Finished groups whose configured DAPO metric is identical across all trajectories.
250	
251	        Returns the filtered uids and a ``{shared_metric_value: group_count}`` breakdown built in the
252	        same scope, so the diagnostic (which reward level the no-signal groups collapse to) travels
253	        with the uids through the return value instead of via hidden instance state.
254	        """
255	        if partition_id == "val" or self.filter_groups_metric is None:
256	            return set(), Counter()
257	
258	        finished_uids = self.finished_keys[partition_id]
259	        classification_cache = self._dapo_classification_cache[partition_id]
260	        for uid in classification_cache.keys() - finished_uids:
261	            del classification_cache[uid]
262	
263	        new_finished_uids = finished_uids - classification_cache.keys()
264	        trajectory_keys = [key for key in self.partitions[partition_id] if key.split("_")[0] in new_finished_uids]
265	        metrics_by_uid: dict[str, list[float]] = defaultdict(list)
266	        missing_metric_uids = new_finished_uids - {key.split("_")[0] for key in trajectory_keys}
267	
268	        if trajectory_keys:
269	            data = tq.kv_batch_get(
270	                keys=trajectory_keys,
271	                partition_id=partition_id,
272	                select_fields=["extra_fields"],
273	            )
274	            extra_fields_list = list(data["extra_fields"])
275	        else:
276	            extra_fields_list = []
277	
278	        for key, extra_fields in zip(trajectory_keys, extra_fields_list, strict=True):
279	            uid = key.split("_")[0]
280	            extra_fields = getattr(extra_fields, "data", extra_fields)
281	            reward_extra_info = extra_fields.get("reward_extra_info", {}) if isinstance(extra_fields, dict) else {}
282	            if self.filter_groups_metric not in reward_extra_info:
283	                missing_metric_uids.add(uid)
284	            else:
285	                metrics_by_uid[uid].append(float(reward_extra_info[self.filter_groups_metric]))
286	
287	        if missing_metric_uids:
288	            raise RuntimeError(
289	                f"Finished groups are missing DAPO metric {self.filter_groups_metric!r}: "
290	                f"{sorted(missing_metric_uids)[:5]}"
291	            )
292	
293	        for uid in new_finished_uids:
294	            values = metrics_by_uid[uid]
295	            classification_cache[uid] = float(values[0]) if len(values) > 1 and float(np.std(values)) == 0.0 else None
296	
297	        filtered_rewards = {uid: reward for uid, reward in classification_cache.items() if reward is not None}
298	        return set(filtered_rewards), Counter(filtered_rewards.values())
299	
300	    def _terminal_eviction_reasons(
301	        self, global_steps: int, partition_id: str
302	    ) -> tuple[set[str], set[str], set[str], Counter]:
303	        """Return stale, DAPO-filtered, and failed groups (plus the DAPO value->count breakdown).
304	
305	        The three sets may overlap. Callers clear and refill their union, so one prompt is never handled
306	        twice. ``dapo_counts`` is the {shared_metric_value: group_count} diagnostic for ``dapo_uids``; it
307	        rides along in the return value so no hidden state is needed between production and consumption.
308	        """
309	        if partition_id == "val":
310	            return set(), set(), set(), Counter()
311	
312	        dapo_uids, dapo_counts = self._dapo_filtered_keys(partition_id)
313	        failed_uids = set()
314	        if self.sync_refill_failed_groups:
315	            materializable_uids = {key.split("_")[0] for key in self.partitions[partition_id]}
316	            failed_uids = self.failure_keys[partition_id] - materializable_uids
317	        return set(), dapo_uids, failed_uids, dapo_counts
318	
319	    def _sampleable_terminal_keys(
320	        self,
321	        partition_id: str,
322	        eviction_reasons: tuple[set[str], set[str], set[str], Counter],
323	    ) -> set[str]:
324	        terminal_uids = self.finished_keys[partition_id] | self.failure_keys[partition_id]
325	        stale_uids, dapo_uids, failed_uids, _dapo_counts = eviction_reasons
326	        return terminal_uids - (stale_uids | dapo_uids | failed_uids)
327	
328	    def _evict_terminal_groups(
329	        self,
330	        global_steps: int,
331	        partition_id: str,
332	        eviction_reasons: tuple[set[str], set[str], set[str], Counter],
333	    ) -> tuple[set[str], int, int, dict]:
334	        """Evict terminal groups selected by any active policy exactly once."""
335	        stale_uids, dapo_uids, failed_uids, dapo_counts = eviction_reasons
336	        evicted_uids = stale_uids | dapo_uids | failed_uids
337	        if not evicted_uids:
338	            return set(), 0, 0, {}
339	
340	        prefix = self._metrics_prefix(partition_id)
341	        metrics: dict = {}
342	        if stale_uids:
343	            prompt_global_steps = self.prompt_global_steps[partition_id]
344	            spans = np.array(
345	                [global_steps - prompt_global_steps.get(uid, global_steps) + 1 for uid in stale_uids],
346	                dtype=float,
347	            )
348	            metrics.update(
349	                {
350	                    f"{prefix}/off_policy/evicted_samples": len(stale_uids),
351	                    f"{prefix}/off_policy/evicted_samples_staleness/mean": spans.mean(),
352	                    f"{prefix}/off_policy/evicted_samples_staleness/max": spans.max(),
353	                    f"{prefix}/off_policy/evicted_samples_staleness/min": spans.min(),
354	                }
355	            )
356	        if dapo_uids:
357	            metrics[f"{prefix}/filter_groups/evicted_samples"] = len(dapo_uids)
358	            # Non-scalar diagnostic: how many filtered (no-signal) groups collapsed to each metric value.
359	            metrics[DAPO_FILTERED_REWARD_COUNTS_KEY] = dict(dapo_counts)
360	        if failed_uids:
361	            metrics[f"{prefix}/rollout_failure/evicted_samples"] = len(failed_uids)
362	
363	        self._clear_groups(partition_id, evicted_uids)
364	        return evicted_uids, len(stale_uids), len(dapo_uids), metrics
365	
366	    def _select_prompt_uids(
367	        self, partition_id: str, sampleable_keys: set[str], batch_size: int
368	    ) -> tuple[list[str], dict[str, dict], dict[str, int]]:
369	        prompt_global_steps_snapshot = dict(self.prompt_global_steps[partition_id])
370	        partition_snapshot = dict(self.partitions[partition_id])
371	        ordered_keys = sorted(
372	            sampleable_keys,
373	            key=lambda key: prompt_global_steps_snapshot.get(key, 0),
374	        )
375	        return ordered_keys[:batch_size], partition_snapshot, prompt_global_steps_snapshot
376	
377	    def _materialize_batch(
378	        self, partition_id: str, selected_prompt_uids: list[str], partition_snapshot: dict[str, dict]
379	    ) -> KVBatchMeta:
380	        tq.kv_clear(partition_id=partition_id, keys=selected_prompt_uids)
381	
382	        keys, tags = [], []
383	        selected = set(selected_prompt_uids)
384	        for key, tag in partition_snapshot.items():
385	            uid = key.split("_")[0]
386	            if uid in selected:
387	                keys.append(key)
388	                tags.append(tag)
389	        return KVBatchMeta(partition_id=partition_id, keys=keys, tags=tags)
390	
391	    def _wait_for_next_poll(self, partition_id: str, last_debug_time: float) -> float:
392	        time.sleep(self.poll_interval)
393	        now = time.time()
394	        if now - last_debug_time > VERL_REPLAY_BUFFER_DEBUG_INTERVAL_SECONDS:
395	            logger.info(
396	                f"pending: {len(self.pending_keys[partition_id])}, "
397	                f"running: {len(self.running_keys[partition_id])}, "
398	                f"finished: {len(self.finished_keys[partition_id])}, "
399	                f"failure: {len(self.failure_keys[partition_id])}"
400	            )
401	            return now
402	        return last_debug_time
403	
404	    @SkipManager.annotate_tq(role="rollout_tq", phase="sample")
405	    def sample(self, global_steps: int, partition_id: str, batch_size: int) -> tuple[KVBatchMeta, dict]:
406	        """Sample a batch using synchronous rollout semantics.
407	
408	        NOTE: user can customize sampling strategy by setting:
409	        ```bash
410	        trainer.v1.sampler.custom_sampler.path = "path/to/your/sampler.py"
411	        trainer.v1.sampler.custom_sampler.name = "UserCustomReplayBuffer"
412	        ```
413	
414	        Args:
415	            global_steps (int): Global steps of the current training.
416	            partition_id (str): Partition of TransferQueue, e.g. "train" or "val".
417	            batch_size (int, optional): Batch size.
418	
419	        Returns:
420	            KVBatchMeta: A batch of data.
421	            dict: Auxiliary metrics.
422	        """
423	        last_debug_time = time.time()
424	        eviction_metrics: dict = {}
425	        dapo_enabled = partition_id != "val" and self.filter_groups_metric is not None
426	        refill_credit = 0
427	        draining = False
428	        max_inflight_prompts = 0
429	        if dapo_enabled:
430	            max_inflight_prompts = self.max_inflight_gen_batches * self.train_batch_size
431	
432	        while True:
433	            # Eviction, gating, and selection below must all use this snapshot.
434	            self._sync_metadata_from_transfer_queue()
435	
436	            eviction_reasons = self._terminal_eviction_reasons(global_steps, partition_id)
437	            failed_count = len(eviction_reasons[2])
438	            evicted_uids, stale_count, dapo_count, metrics = self._evict_terminal_groups(
439	                global_steps, partition_id, eviction_reasons
440	            )
441	            if evicted_uids:
442	                _accumulate_eviction_metrics(eviction_metrics, metrics, stale_count)
443	
444	            sampleable_keys = self._sampleable_terminal_keys(partition_id, eviction_reasons)
445	            has_enough_samples = len(sampleable_keys) >= batch_size
446	            inflight_count = len(self.pending_keys[partition_id]) + len(self.running_keys[partition_id])
447	
448	            if not dapo_enabled and failed_count > 0 and not has_enough_samples:
449	                self.refill_fn(failed_count)
450	                continue
451	
452	            if dapo_enabled:
453	                if has_enough_samples:
454	                    # Stop speculative dispatch, then drain requests already running under this policy version.
455	                    draining = True
456	                    refill_credit = 0
457	                elif not draining:
458	                    refill_credit += 2 * dapo_count + failed_count
459	
460	                if not draining and refill_credit > 0:
461	                    available_slots = max(0, max_inflight_prompts - inflight_count)
462	                    dispatch_count = min(refill_credit, available_slots)
463	                    assert self.gen_batch_size is not None
464	                    dispatch_count -= dispatch_count % self.gen_batch_size
465	                    if dispatch_count > 0:
466	                        assert self.refill_fn is not None
467	                        self.refill_fn(dispatch_count)
468	                        refill_credit -= dispatch_count
469	                        continue
470	
471	            can_select = has_enough_samples and (not dapo_enabled or inflight_count == 0)
472	            if can_select:
473	                selected_prompt_uids, partition_snapshot, _prompt_global_steps_snapshot = self._select_prompt_uids(
474	                    partition_id, sampleable_keys, batch_size
475	                )
476	
477	                # Sync remains bufferless: all speculative requests are drained, then surplus is discarded.
478	                if dapo_enabled:
479	                    surplus_uids = sampleable_keys - set(selected_prompt_uids)
480	                    if surplus_uids:
481	                        self._clear_groups(partition_id, surplus_uids)
482	                        key = f"{self._metrics_prefix(partition_id)}/filter_groups/discarded_surplus_samples"
483	                        eviction_metrics[key] = eviction_metrics.get(key, 0) + len(surplus_uids)
484	                break
485	
486	            last_debug_time = self._wait_for_next_poll(partition_id, last_debug_time)
487	
488	        selected_uids = set(selected_prompt_uids)
489	        if partition_id != "val" and not any(key.split("_")[0] in selected_uids for key in partition_snapshot):
490	            message = "Sync replay buffer selected terminal groups with no materializable trajectories."
491	            if not self.sync_refill_failed_groups:
492	                message += " Enable trainer.v1.sampler.sync_refill_failed_groups to replace failed groups."
493	            raise RuntimeError(message)
494	        return self._materialize_batch(partition_id, selected_prompt_uids, partition_snapshot), eviction_metrics
495

steps.message:
This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   - The original task was **“RL training run diagnosis”**: inspect the staged workspace as a historical snapshot and decide whether the post-training experiment was **healthy or unhealthy**.
   - Required evidence included:
     - Source code and effective configuration.
     - Launch script and data preprocessing.
     - Reward implementation and metric semantics.
     - Logs and tracked training metrics.
     - Rollout, truncation, runtime, and optimization signals.
     - Frozen held-out evaluation.
   - Explicit cautions from the user:
     - **“Training reward alone does not establish held-out health.”**
     - **“A truncated log is not by itself proof of a defect.”**
     - Do not infer causality merely because an implementation or setting is unusual; connect proposed causes to observed behavior.
   - Constraints:
     - Do not launch a full training run.
     - Do not use the network.
     - Do not modify the historical snapshot.
     - Dataset, held-out set, model, training-step budget, and evaluation interval are fixed.
     - Do not propose or implement a fix.
     - Do not write other deliverable files.
   - Required final deliverable: exactly one concise UTF-8 diagnosis at `$PTDBENCH_RESULTS/agent_answer.md`. The observed expansion was `PTDBENCH_RESULTS=/logs/artifacts`, making the target:
     - `/logs/artifacts/agent_answer.md`
   - That diagnosis must give the verdict, concrete root cause(s), a causal chain supported by specific workspace evidence, and a clear distinction between root causes and symptoms.
   - Two intervening user turns requested only detailed conversation summaries, with an `<analysis>` block followed by a `<summary>` block and no tools. The current turn repeats that summary-only requirement.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - GRPO post-training with verl’s synchronous V1 trainer.
   - Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on eight GPUs, FSDP2, vLLM, bf16 compute with fp32 model dtype, and parameter/optimizer offload.
   - Geometry3k rule-based reward:
     - 90% answer correctness using `mathruler`.
     - 10% strict `<think>...</think>` plus `\boxed{...}` formatting.
   - Five rollouts per training prompt, training batch 32, PPO mini-batch 16, one PPO epoch.
   - KL loss coefficient 0.01 and no entropy bonus.
   - Baseline and held-out evaluations every five steps over 601 examples; total budget 20 steps.
   - Training sampling uses temperature 1.0; validation uses temperature 0 and one generation per example.
   - Difference between training reward improvement and held-out generalization.
   - Difference between response-length clipping and explicit rollout aborts.
   - Difference between training completion and later exit/atexit exceptions.
   - Rollout/actor consistency measured through probability correlations, perplexity ratios, log-perplexity differences, and trajectory staleness.
   - Reward-manager fallback semantics: a scalar result is copied into `reward_extra_info["acc"]`; this does not create an independently computed binary accuracy metric.
   - Because validation scores are only 0 or approximately 0.9, binary grader-correctness counts can be recovered from the frozen distributions.
   - `/workspace` is a symlink; recursive inventory requires `find -L /workspace`.
   - Read-only analyses used `python3 -I`; no training or network access was performed.

3. Files and Code Sections:
   - `/workspace/run_qwen3vl_geo3k_grpo.sh`
     - Read in full; unchanged.
     - Important settings:
       ```bash
       MODEL_PATH="${MODEL_PATH:-$WORKSPACE/models/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct}"
       TRAIN_FILE="${TRAIN_FILE:-$WORKSPACE/data/geo3k/train.parquet}"
       TEST_FILE="${TEST_FILE:-$WORKSPACE/data/geo3k/test.parquet}"
       TOTAL_TRAINING_STEPS="${TOTAL_TRAINING_STEPS:-20}"
       ```
       ```bash
       data.train_batch_size=32
       data.max_prompt_length=2048
       data.max_response_length=8192
       data.image_patch_size=16
       data.filter_overlong_prompts=True
       data.truncation=error
       actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.lr=1e-6
       actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_mini_batch_size=16
       actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_kl_loss=True
       actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_coef=0.01
       actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_type=low_var_kl
       actor_rollout_ref.actor.entropy_coeff=0
       actor_rollout_ref.rollout.max_model_len=10240
       actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=5
       trainer.use_v1=True
       trainer.v1.trainer_mode=sync
       trainer.val_before_train=True
       trainer.test_freq=5
       trainer.save_freq=20
       trainer.total_training_steps="$TOTAL_TRAINING_STEPS"
       ```
     - Uses offline W&B and offline Hugging Face modes.

   - `/workspace/verl/examples/data_preprocess/geo3k.py`
     - Read in full.
     - Loads `hiyouga/geometry3k`, retains the source `train` and `test` splits, and preserves the problem, answer, and images.
     - Prompt instruction:
       ```python
       instruction_following = (
           r"You FIRST think about the reasoning process as an internal monologue and then provide the final answer. "
           r"The reasoning process MUST BE enclosed within <think> </think> tags. "
           r"The final answer MUST BE put in \boxed{}."
       )
       ```
     - Reward metadata:
       ```python
       "reward_model": {"style": "rule", "ground_truth": answer}
       ```

   - `/workspace/verl/verl/utils/reward_score/geo3k.py`
     - Read in full; central scoring implementation:
       ```python
       def format_reward(predict_str: str) -> float:
           pattern = re.compile(r"<think>.*</think>.*\\boxed\{.*\}.*", re.DOTALL)
           match_result = re.fullmatch(pattern, predict_str)
           return 1.0 if match_result else 0.0

       def acc_reward(predict_str: str, ground_truth: str, use_boxed: bool = True) -> float:
           if use_boxed:
               answer = extract_boxed_content(predict_str)
           else:
               answer = predict_str
           return 1.0 if grade_answer(answer, ground_truth) else 0.0

       def compute_score(predict_str: str, ground_truth: str, use_boxed: bool = True, format_score: float = 0.1) -> float:
           return (1.0 - format_score) * acc_reward(predict_str, ground_truth, use_boxed) + format_score * format_reward(
               predict_str
           )
       ```
     - A correct boxed answer without the required think tags scores 0.9. A completely correct and correctly formatted answer scores 1.0.

   - `/workspace/verl/verl/experimental/reward_loop/reward_manager/naive.py`
     - Read in full.
     - Decodes valid response tokens and invokes the configured/default score function.
     - Critical scalar-result behavior:
       ```python
       if isinstance(result, dict):
           score = result["score"]
           for key, value in result.items():
               reward_extra_info[key] = value
       else:
           score = result
           reward_extra_info["acc"] = score

       reward = score
       return {"reward_score": reward, "reward_extra_info": reward_extra_info}
       ```
     - Therefore Geometry3k’s combined scalar score is duplicated under the name `acc`.

   - `/workspace/verl/verl/trainer/ppo/reward.py`
     - Read the custom reward and manager resolution paths.
     - No external custom reward path is configured; the default scoring registry is used.

   - `/workspace/verl/verl/trainer/ppo/v1/trainer_base.py`
     - Read initialization, the training loop, validation, dumping, and validation metric handling.
     - Baseline validation occurs before training; scheduled validation occurs at the configured interval and at the last step.
     - The final-step path saves, validates, logs metrics, drains dump futures, prints final validation metrics, and returns after step 20.
     - `_validate` gathers scalar `rm_scores` and `reward_extra_info`.
     - Headline metric selection:
       ```python
       core_var = "acc" if "acc" in var2metric2val else "reward"
       ```
     - Since the naive reward manager inserts `acc=score`, `val-core/.../acc/mean@1` is the combined scalar reward, not an independently computed accuracy.
     - Current `_write_generations` normally writes `input` and `output`, but the staged frozen validation records contain only `gts`, `score`, `step`, `reward`, `acc`, and `uid`. No conclusion was drawn about why the staged records differ.

   - `/workspace/verl/verl/trainer/ppo/v1/agent_loop_tq.py`
     - Read in full.
     - Training uses configured temperature/top-p/top-k and repetition penalty 1.0.
     - Validation overrides these with `val_kwargs`.
     - Reward computation occurs in `_agent_loop_postprocess`; outputs and multimodal tensors are placed into TransferQueue.

   - `/workspace/verl/verl/trainer/ppo/v1/replay_buffer.py`
     - Read the synchronous sampling and terminal-group logic.
     - Synchronous sampling is on-policy; logged zero staleness is consistent with this design.
     - Rollout group failures are distinct from length clipping.

   - `/workspace/verl/verl/utils/dataset/rl_dataset.py`
     - `_build_messages` replaces `<image>` placeholders with structured image content in order and asserts all images/placeholders are consumed.
     - Multimodal prompt lengths are computed through the processor during filtering.
     - Filtering exceptions mark examples overlong, but the logs show no examples were actually removed: 2101 training and 601 validation examples remained.
     - V1 processing returns `raw_prompt`; chat templating is deferred to the agent loop.

   - `/workspace/models/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct/chat_template.json`
     - Inspected.
     - It renders the user message and then `<|im_start|>assistant\n`; it does not itself insert `<think>` tags.
     - This is context for the generations, not proof of a template defect, because the explicit user instruction still requests those tags.

   - `/workspace/models/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct/config.json`
     - Read in full.
     - Model type is `qwen3_vl`; vision patch size is 16 and spatial merge size is 2.
     - The launch script’s `image_patch_size=16` is therefore consistent with the model configuration.

   - `/workspace/logs/recorded_run/metrics.csv`
     - Contains baseline and steps 1–20.
     - Logged held-out `val-core/hiyouga/geometry3k/acc/mean@1`:
       | Step | Combined reward |
       |---|---:|
       | 0 | 0.5136439268 |
       | 5 | 0.5510815308 |
       | 10 | 0.5241264559 |
       | 15 | 0.5286189684 |
       | 20 | 0.5316139767 |
     - Final score is about 1.80 percentage points above baseline but about 1.95 points below the step-5 peak.
     - Training `critic/score/mean` fluctuates between 0.399375 and 0.720000, ending at 0.590625; every step has maximum 0.9 and minimum 0.
     - Stable optimization/runtime signals:
       - Entropy range approximately 0.3820–0.4407; final 0.38565.
       - Gradient norms approximately 0.281–0.731.
       - PPO clip fractions approximately 0.000264–0.000686.
       - Very small PPO KL; final KL loss approximately 0.003361.
       - Rollout/actor Pearson correlation approximately 0.9913–0.9943.
       - PPL ratio approximately 1.0076–1.0134.
       - Trajectory staleness zero and span one.
       - `response/aborted_ratio=0` throughout.
       - Response maximum is 8192 throughout; clip ratio ranges 0.03125–0.15625.
       - Mean response length fluctuates around 1842–3406 tokens rather than increasing monotonically.
       - Training steps take approximately 109–140 seconds, excluding separately recorded validation time.
       - Memory stabilizes around 59.73 GB allocated and 70.36 GB reserved.

   - `/workspace/logs/recorded_run/metrics.json`
     - Initial records inspected; they are consistent with the CSV’s per-step dictionaries and baseline values.
     - No additional contradictory evidence was found.

   - `/workspace/logs/recorded_run/validation/{0,5,10,15,20}.jsonl`
     - Read-only Python analysis confirmed 601 records at every evaluation.
     - Exact rounded score distributions:
       | Step | Score 0 | Score ≈0.9 |

     - The output repeatedly revisits trigonometric calculations and ends mid-expression:
       ```text
       Area = 1.75 * h = 1
       ```
     - No `<think>` tags and no `\boxed{...}`.
     - This is consistent with response-length clipping contributing to that sample’s zero reward.
     - Aggregate step-10 response clip ratio is 7.5%; this single sample must not be generalized into a run-wide truncation or abort failure.

   - `/workspace/logs/recorded_run/rollouts/20.jsonl`

   - `/workspace/logs/recorded_run/train.log`

     - Final validation and `Training Progress: 100% ... 20/20` are present.
     - W&B `ConnectionResetError: Connection lost` and DataLoader worker termination appear afterward in exit/atexit handling.
     - These are teardown symptoms/noise, not evidenced causes of the training or validation curves.

   - `/workspace/data/asset_manifest.json`
     - Model: `Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct`, revision `fe3340460dc1b2245a90d1b3b608bc86ffb3bfd6`.

   - `/workspace/data/parity/cases.json`

   - Prepared parquet inspection:
     - `/workspace/data/geo3k/train.parquet`: 2101 rows, each with one image and one `<image>` placeholder, unique source indices 0–2100, and expected source/split metadata.
     - `/workspace/data/geo3k/test.parquet`: 601 examples confirmed through logs/frozen evaluation.
     - No exhaustive source-to-prepared comparison, train/test overlap analysis, image-label correctness audit, or hash verification was performed.

   - `/workspace/verl/AGENTS.md` and `/workspace/verl/CLAUDE.md`
     - Repository instructions concern contributions, PRs, and code modifications.
     - They do not alter this read-only diagnostic task; no commits, PRs, or source edits are planned.

   - No files have been created or modified. In particular, `/logs/artifacts/agent_answer.md` has not yet been written.

4. Errors and fixes:
   - Initial `find /workspace` missed files because `/workspace` is a symlink.

def compute_data_metrics(batch: DataProto, use_critic: bool = True) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Computes various metrics from a batch of data for PPO training.

    This function calculates metrics related to scores, rewards, advantages, returns, values,
    and sequence lengths from a batch of data. It provides statistical information (mean, max, min)
    for each metric category.

    Args:
        batch: A DataProto object containing batch data with token-level scores, rewards, advantages, etc.
        use_critic: Whether to include critic-specific metrics. Defaults to True.

    Returns:
        A dictionary of metrics including:
            - critic/score/mean, max, min: Statistics about sequence scores
            - critic/rewards/mean, max, min: Statistics about sequence rewards
            - critic/advantages/mean, max, min: Statistics about advantages
            - critic/returns/mean, max, min: Statistics about returns
            - critic/values/mean, max, min: Statistics about critic values (if use_critic=True)
            - critic/vf_explained_var: Explained variance of the value function (if use_critic=True)
            - response_length/mean, max, min, clip_ratio: Statistics about response lengths
            - prompt_length/mean, max, min, clip_ratio: Statistics about prompt lengths
            - num_turns/mean, max, min: Statistics about the number of multi-turn conversations
    """
    sequence_score = batch.batch["token_level_scores"].sum(-1)
    sequence_reward = batch.batch["token_level_rewards"].sum(-1)

    advantages = batch.batch["advantages"]
    returns = batch.batch["returns"]

    max_prompt_length = batch.batch["prompts"].shape[-1]
    max_response_length = batch.batch["responses"].shape[-1]

    response_mask = batch.batch["response_mask"].bool()

    response_info = _compute_response_info(batch)
    prompt_length = response_info["prompt_length"]
    response_length = response_info["response_length"]

    aborted_mask = (response_length == 0).bool()
    non_aborted_mask = ~aborted_mask

    non_aborted_sequence_score = sequence_score[non_aborted_mask]
    non_aborted_sequence_reward = sequence_reward[non_aborted_mask]

    if non_aborted_sequence_score.numel() > 0:
        score_mean = torch.mean(non_aborted_sequence_score).detach().item()
        score_max = torch.max(non_aborted_sequence_score).detach().item()
        score_min = torch.min(non_aborted_sequence_score).detach().item()
    else:
        logger.warning("All samples are aborted, returning default score metrics")
        score_mean = score_max = score_min = float("nan")

    if non_aborted_sequence_reward.numel() > 0:
        reward_mean = torch.mean(non_aborted_sequence_reward).detach().item()
        reward_max = torch.max(non_aborted_sequence_reward).detach().item()
        reward_min = torch.min(non_aborted_sequence_reward).detach().item()
    else:
        logger.warning("All samples are aborted, returning default reward metrics")
        reward_mean = reward_max = reward_min = float("nan")

    valid_adv = torch.masked_select(advantages, response_mask)
    valid_returns = torch.masked_select(returns, response_mask)

    if valid_adv.numel() > 0:
        adv_mean = torch.mean(valid_adv).detach().item()
        adv_max = torch.max(valid_adv).detach().item()
        adv_min = torch.min(valid_adv).detach().item()
    else:
        logger.warning("Response mask is all False, returning default advantage metrics")
        adv_mean = adv_max = adv_min = float("nan")

    if valid_returns.numel() > 0:
        returns_mean = torch.mean(valid_returns).detach().item()
        returns_max = torch.max(valid_returns).detach().item()
        returns_min = torch.min(valid_returns).detach().item()
    else:
        logger.warning("Response mask is all False, returning default return metrics")
        returns_mean = returns_max = returns_min = float("nan")

    # Aborted samples and non-aborted response length statistics
    # response_length_non_aborted/*: statistics computed on non-aborted samples only
    aborted_ratio = torch.mean(aborted_mask.float()).detach().item()

    non_aborted_response_length = response_length[non_aborted_mask]
    if non_aborted_response_length.numel() > 0:
        non_aborted_response_length_mean = torch.mean(non_aborted_response_length).detach().item()
        non_aborted_response_length_max = torch.max(non_aborted_response_length).detach().item()
        non_aborted_response_length_min = torch.min(non_aborted_response_length).detach().item()
        non_aborted_response_length_clip_ratio = (
            torch.mean(torch.eq(non_aborted_response_length, max_response_length).float()).detach().item()
        )
    else:
        logger.warning("All samples are aborted, returning default response length metrics")
        non_aborted_response_length_mean = float("nan")
        non_aborted_response_length_max = float("nan")
        non_aborted_response_length_min = float("nan")
        non_aborted_response_length_clip_ratio = float("nan")

    if use_critic:
        values = batch.batch["values"]
        valid_values = torch.masked_select(values, response_mask)
        if valid_returns.numel() > 0 and valid_values.numel() > 0:
            return_diff_var = torch.var(valid_returns - valid_values)
            return_var = torch.var(valid_returns)
            critic_value_metrics = {
                # values
                "critic/values/mean": torch.mean(valid_values).detach().item(),
                "critic/values/max": torch.max(valid_values).detach().item(),
                "critic/values/min": torch.min(valid_values).detach().item(),
                # vf explained var
                "critic/vf_explained_var": (1.0 - return_diff_var / (return_var + 1e-5)).detach().item(),
            }
        else:
            logger.warning("Response mask is all False, returning default value metrics")
            critic_value_metrics = {
                "critic/values/mean": float("nan"),
                "critic/values/max": float("nan"),
                "critic/values/min": float("nan"),
                # vf explained var
                "critic/vf_explained_var": float("nan"),
            }
    else:
        critic_value_metrics = {}

    metrics = {
        # score
        "critic/score/mean": score_mean,
        "critic/score/max": score_max,
        "critic/score/min": score_min,
        # reward
        "critic/rewards/mean": reward_mean,
        "critic/rewards/max": reward_max,
        "critic/rewards/min": reward_min,
        # adv
        "critic/advantages/mean": adv_mean,
        "critic/advantages/max": adv_max,
        "critic/advantages/min": adv_min,
        # returns
        "critic/returns/mean": returns_mean,
        "critic/returns/max": returns_max,
        "critic/returns/min": returns_min,
        **critic_value_metrics,
        # response length
        "response_length/mean": torch.mean(response_length).detach().item(),
        "response_length/max": torch.max(response_length).detach().item(),
        "response_length/min": torch.min(response_length).detach().item(),
        "response_length/clip_ratio": torch.mean(torch.eq(response_length, max_response_length).float())
        .detach()
        .item(),
        # response length (non-aborted only)
        # These statistics exclude aborted samples to avoid skew from zeros
        "response_length_non_aborted/mean": non_aborted_response_length_mean,
        "response_length_non_aborted/max": non_aborted_response_length_max,
        "response_length_non_aborted/min": non_aborted_response_length_min,
        "response_length_non_aborted/clip_ratio": non_aborted_response_length_clip_ratio,
        # aborted ratio
        # Fraction of samples whose response length is zero
        "response/aborted_ratio": aborted_ratio,
        # prompt length
        "prompt_length/mean": torch.mean(prompt_length).detach().item(),
        "prompt_length/max": torch.max(prompt_length).detach().item(),
        "prompt_length/min": torch.min(prompt_length).detach().item(),
        "prompt_length/clip_ratio": torch.mean(torch.eq(prompt_length, max_prompt_length).float()).detach().item(),
    }

    # multi-turn conversation
    if "__num_turns__" in batch.non_tensor_batch:
        num_turns = batch.non_tensor_batch["__num_turns__"]
        metrics["num_turns/min"] = num_turns.min()
        metrics["num_turns/max"] = num_turns.max()
        metrics["num_turns/mean"] = num_turns.mean()

    if "tool_call_counts" in batch.non_tensor_batch:
        tool_call_counts = batch.non_tensor_batch["tool_call_counts"]
        metrics["tool_call_counts/min"] = tool_call_counts.min()
        metrics["tool_call_counts/max"] = tool_call_counts.max()
        metrics["tool_call_counts/mean"] = tool_call_counts.mean()

    return metrics


def compute_timing_metrics(batch: DataProto, timing_raw: dict[str, float]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """
    Computes timing metrics for different processing stages in PPO training.

    This function calculates both raw timing metrics (in seconds) and per-token timing metrics
    (in milliseconds) for various processing stages like generation, reference computation,
    value computation, advantage computation, and model updates.

    Args:
        batch: A DataProto object containing batch data with responses and attention masks.
        timing_raw: A dictionary mapping stage names to their execution times in seconds.

    Returns:
        A dictionary containing:
            - timing_s/{name}: Raw timing in seconds for each stage
            - timing_per_token_ms/{name}: Per-token timing in milliseconds for each stage

    Note:
        Different stages use different token counts for normalization:
        - "gen" uses only response tokens
        - Other stages ("ref", "values", "adv", "update_critic", "update_actor") use all tokens
          (prompt + response)
    """
    response_info = _compute_response_info(batch)
    num_prompt_tokens = torch.sum(response_info["prompt_length"]).item()
    num_response_tokens = torch.sum(response_info["response_length"]).item()
    num_overall_tokens = num_prompt_tokens + num_response_tokens

    num_tokens_of_section = {
        "gen": num_response_tokens,
        **{name: num_overall_tokens for name in ["ref", "values", "adv", "update_critic", "update_actor"]},
    }

    return {
        **{f"timing_s/{name}": value for name, value in timing_raw.items()},
        **{
            f"timing_per_token_ms/{name}": (
                timing_raw[name] * 1000 / num_tokens_of_section[name] if num_tokens_of_section[name] > 0 else 0.0
            )
            for name in set(num_tokens_of_section.keys()) & set(timing_raw.keys())
        },
    }

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# GRPO | Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct | geometry3k | FSDP + vLLM
set -euo pipefail
export PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1
unset PYTHONHOME
WORKSPACE="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
# Optional shared venv for the selected existing image. In the task Docker
# image, leave this unset and use the image's already-installed environment.
if [[ -n "${QWEN3VL_ENV_DIR:-}" ]]; then
    [[ -x "$QWEN3VL_ENV_DIR/bin/python" ]] || { printf 'Missing environment: %s\n' "$QWEN3VL_ENV_DIR" >&2; exit 2; }
    export VIRTUAL_ENV="$QWEN3VL_ENV_DIR"
    export PATH="$VIRTUAL_ENV/bin:$PATH"
    RUNTIME_SITE="$(python3 -c 'import sysconfig; print(sysconfig.get_paths()["purelib"])')"
    RUNTIME_LIBS="$(python3 - "$RUNTIME_SITE" <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import sys
site = Path(sys.argv[1])
print(':'.join([str(site / 'torch/lib')] + [str(p) for p in sorted((site / 'nvidia').rglob('lib')) if p.is_dir()]))
PY
)"
    export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$RUNTIME_LIBS${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:+:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH}"
    if [[ -x "$RUNTIME_SITE/nvidia/cu13/bin/nvcc" ]]; then
        export CUDA_HOME="$RUNTIME_SITE/nvidia/cu13"
        export PATH="$CUDA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
        export CPATH="$CUDA_HOME/include/cccl${CPATH:+:$CPATH}"
    fi
fi
export PYTHONPATH="$WORKSPACE/verl${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
MODEL_PATH="${MODEL_PATH:-$WORKSPACE/models/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct}"
TRAIN_FILE="${TRAIN_FILE:-$WORKSPACE/data/geo3k/train.parquet}"
TEST_FILE="${TEST_FILE:-$WORKSPACE/data/geo3k/test.parquet}"
LOG_DIR="${LOG_DIR:-$WORKSPACE/logs}"
NGPUS_PER_NODE="${NGPUS_PER_NODE:-8}"
TOTAL_TRAINING_STEPS="${TOTAL_TRAINING_STEPS:-20}"
mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
export WANDB_MODE=offline WANDB_API_KEY=offline
export WANDB_DIR="${WANDB_DIR:-$LOG_DIR}"
export HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1 HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
export VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD=spawn
for asset in "$MODEL_PATH/config.json" "$TRAIN_FILE" "$TEST_FILE"; do
    [[ -f "$asset" ]] || { printf 'Missing prepared asset: %s\n' "$asset" >&2; exit 2; }
done
cd "$WORKSPACE/verl"
python3 -m verl.trainer.main_ppo \
    algorithm.adv_estimator=grpo \
    algorithm.use_kl_in_reward=False \
    data.train_files="$TRAIN_FILE" \
    data.val_files="$TEST_FILE" \
    data.train_batch_size=32 \
    data.max_prompt_length=2048 \
    data.max_response_length=8192 \
    data.image_key=images \
    data.image_patch_size=16 \
    data.filter_overlong_prompts=True \
    data.truncation=error \
    data.dataloader_num_workers=2 \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.path="$MODEL_PATH" \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.use_remove_padding=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.model.enable_gradient_checkpointing=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.strategy=fsdp2 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.lr=1e-6 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_mini_batch_size=16 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_dynamic_bsz=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu=16384 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_kl_loss=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_coef=0.01 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_type=low_var_kl \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.entropy_coeff=0 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.model_dtype=fp32 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.dtype=bfloat16 \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.param_offload=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.optimizer_offload=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.ulysses_sequence_parallel_size=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.max_model_len=10240 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization=0.4 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=5 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_use_dynamic_bsz=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu=16384 \
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_micro_batch_size_per_gpu=1 \
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_use_dynamic_bsz=True \
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu=16384 \
    trainer.use_v1=True \
    trainer.v1.trainer_mode=sync \
    trainer.n_gpus_per_node="$NGPUS_PER_NODE" \
    trainer.nnodes=1 \
    trainer.logger='[console,wandb]' \
    trainer.project_name=geometry3k_grpo \
    trainer.experiment_name=qwen3vl_8b_fsdp \
    trainer.resume_mode=disable \
    trainer.val_before_train=True \
    trainer.test_freq=5 \
    trainer.save_freq=20 \
    trainer.total_training_steps="$TOTAL_TRAINING_STEPS" \
    trainer.total_epochs=15 \
    trainer.default_local_dir="$LOG_DIR/checkpoints" \
    trainer.rollout_data_dir="$LOG_DIR/rollouts" \
    trainer.validation_data_dir="$LOG_DIR/validation" \
    "$@" 2>&1 | tee "$LOG_DIR/train.log"

import re

from mathruler.grader import extract_boxed_content, grade_answer


def format_reward(predict_str: str) -> float:
    pattern = re.compile(r"<think>.*</think>.*\\boxed\{.*\}.*", re.DOTALL)
    match_result = re.fullmatch(pattern, predict_str)
    return 1.0 if match_result else 0.0


def acc_reward(predict_str: str, ground_truth: str, use_boxed: bool = True) -> float:
    if use_boxed:
        answer = extract_boxed_content(predict_str)
    else:
        answer = predict_str
    return 1.0 if grade_answer(answer, ground_truth) else 0.0


def compute_score(predict_str: str, ground_truth: str, use_boxed: bool = True, format_score: float = 0.1) -> float:
    return (1.0 - format_score) * acc_reward(predict_str, ground_truth, use_boxed) + format_score * format_reward(
        predict_str
    )

def reset(self):
        self.metric_values.clear()
        self.metric_weights.clear()
        self.dict_metrics.clear()
        self.step_count = 0


def compute_advantage_for_multi_trajectories(
    data: DataProto,
    batch_keys: list[str],
    adv_estimator,
    gamma: float = 1.0,
    lam: float = 1.0,
    num_repeat: int = 1,
    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: bool = True,
    config: Any = None,
) -> DataProto:
    """Compute GRPO advantages from each session's final output. For non-GRPO
    estimators, such as GAE, are delegated to the original compute_advantage() unchanged.

    For GRPO, only the final output in each ``{uid}_{session_id}`` group participates
    in advantage computation, and the result is broadcast to the other outputs in
    the same session. Sessions whose AgentLoop returns ``None`` simply do not appear
    in ``batch_keys``. Non-GRPO estimators, such as GAE, are delegated to the
    original ``compute_advantage()`` unchanged.
    """
    if adv_estimator != core_algos.AdvantageEstimator.GRPO:
        return compute_advantage(
            data,
            adv_estimator=adv_estimator,
            gamma=gamma,
            lam=lam,
            num_repeat=num_repeat,
            norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo=norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo,
            config=config,
        )

    # final session of each agent loop: {uid}_{session_id} => (index, row_index)
    final_sessions: dict[str, tuple[int, int]] = {}
    row_session_keys = []
    for i, key in enumerate(batch_keys):
        fields = key.rsplit("_", 2)
        assert len(fields) == 3, f"Unexpected key format: {key}"
        uid, session_id, index = fields[0], fields[1], int(fields[2])
        session_key = f"{uid}_{session_id}"
        row_session_keys.append(session_key)
        if session_key not in final_sessions or final_sessions[session_key][0] < index:
            final_sessions[session_key] = (index, i)

    # final session indices in batch data
    final_indices = []
    session_key_to_local_index = {}
    for session_key, (_, row_index) in final_sessions.items():
        final_indices.append(row_index)
        session_key_to_local_index[session_key] = len(final_indices) - 1
    row_to_local_index = [session_key_to_local_index[session_key] for session_key in row_session_keys]

    # select final sessions from batch data for group relative advantage computation
    final_data = compute_advantage(
        data.select_idxs(final_indices),
        adv_estimator=adv_estimator,
        gamma=gamma,
        lam=lam,
        num_repeat=num_repeat,
        norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo=norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo,
        config=config,
    )
    first_nnz_indices = final_data.batch["response_mask"].argmax(dim=1)
    final_scores = final_data.batch["advantages"][torch.arange(len(final_data)), first_nnz_indices]

    # scatter final scores to all rows in batch data
    scores = final_scores[row_to_local_index]
    scores = scores.unsqueeze(-1) * data.batch["response_mask"]

    data.batch["advantages"] = scores
    data.batch["returns"] = scores
    return data

    def step(self, metrics: dict, timing_raw: dict) -> KVBatchMeta:
        train_batch_size = self.config.data.train_batch_size
        assert train_batch_size % self.parameter_sync_step == 0, (
            f"train_batch_size ({train_batch_size}) must be divisible by "
            f"parameter_sync_step ({self.parameter_sync_step})"
        )
        sample_batch_size = train_batch_size // self.parameter_sync_step

        self._add_batch_to_generate()

        metrics_aggregator = MetricsAggregator()
        combined_keys: list = []
        combined_tags: list = []
        combined_partition_id = "train"
        for trigger_idx in range(self.parameter_sync_step):
            self.local_trigger_step = trigger_idx
            iter_metrics: dict = {}
            batch = self._step_once(iter_metrics, timing_raw, sample_batch_size)
            sample_count = sum(not tag.get("is_padding", False) for tag in batch.tags)
            metrics_aggregator.add_step_metrics(iter_metrics, sample_count=sample_count)
            combined_keys.extend(batch.keys)
            combined_tags.extend(batch.tags)
            combined_partition_id = batch.partition_id

        metrics.update(metrics_aggregator.get_aggregated_metrics())
        return KVBatchMeta(partition_id=combined_partition_id, keys=combined_keys, tags=combined_tags)

    def _step_once(self, metrics: dict, timing_raw: dict, sample_batch_size: int) -> KVBatchMeta:
        """Run a single local update: sample one mini-batch and perform the full PPO pipeline once."""
        # 1. sample batch from replay buffer
        with marked_timer("gen", timing_raw, color="red"):
            self.on_sample_begin()
            batch, off_policy_metrics = self.replay_buffer.sample(
                global_steps=self.global_steps,
                partition_id="train",
                batch_size=sample_batch_size,
            )
            metrics.update(off_policy_metrics)
            batch.extra_info["temperature"] = self.config.actor_rollout_ref.rollout.temperature
            self.on_sample_end()

        # 2. [OPTIONAL] compute reward score with colocated reward model
        if self.reward_loop_manager.reward_loop_worker_handles is None:
            with marked_timer("reward", timing_raw, color="yellow"):
                batch = self._compute_reward_colocate(batch, metrics=metrics)

        # 3. balance batch across data parallel groups
        batch = self._balance_batch(batch, metrics=metrics)

        # 4. compute old_log_prob
        with marked_timer("old_log_prob", timing_raw, color="blue"):
            batch = self._compute_old_log_prob(batch, metrics=metrics)

        # 5. [OPTIONAL] compute ref_log_prob
        if self.use_reference_policy:
            with marked_timer("ref", timing_raw, color="olive"):
                batch = self._compute_ref_log_prob(batch, metrics=metrics)

        # 6. [OPTIONAL] compute critic values
        if self.use_critic:
            with marked_timer("values", timing_raw, color="cyan"):
                batch = self._compute_values(batch, metrics=metrics)

        # 7. compute advantage and return
        with marked_timer("adv", timing_raw, color="brown"):
            batch = self._compute_advantage(batch, metrics=metrics)

        # 8. [OPTIONAL] update critic
        if self.use_critic:
            with marked_timer("update_critic", timing_raw, color="pink"):
                batch = self._update_critic(batch, metrics=metrics)

        # 9. update actor
        if self.config.trainer.critic_warmup <= self.global_steps:
            with marked_timer("update_actor", timing_raw, color="red"):
                batch = self._update_actor(batch, metrics=metrics)

        return batch

    # ------------------------------ abstract methods ------------------------------

    def on_init_end(self):
        """Called after the initialization ends."""
        return

    def on_train_begin(self):
        """Called before the training loop starts."""
        return

    def on_train_end(self):
        """Called after the training loop ends."""
        return

    def on_validate_begin(self):
        """Called before the validation loop starts."""
        return

    def on_validate_end(self):
        """Called after the validation loop ends."""
        return

    def on_step_begin(self):
        """Called at the beginning of each training step."""
        return

    @abstractmethod
    def on_step_end(self):
        """Called at the end of each training step."""
        return

    def _consume_sync_metrics(self) -> dict:
        """Weight-sync stats stashed by ``on_step_end`` (e.g. the delta engines'
        changed ratio / wire payload), merged into this step's logged metrics."""
        metrics = getattr(self, "_pending_sync_metrics", None) or {}
        self._pending_sync_metrics = {}
        return metrics

    def on_sample_begin(self):
        """Called at the beginning of sampling batch from replay buffer."""
        return

    @abstractmethod
    def on_sample_end(self):
        """Called after sampling a batch from replay buffer."""
        return

    # ------------------------------ common methods ------------------------------

    def _get_n_gpus_for_throughput(self) -> int:
        """Return the total number of GPUs used for throughput normalization.

        By default this is the trainer-side GPU count from the resource pool
        manager.  Modes that use additional dedicated GPUs (e.g. separate-async
        standalone rollout) should override this to include them.
        """
        return self.resource_pool_manager.get_n_gpus()

    def _init_tokenizer(self):
        """Initialize tokenizer and processor from the model config."""
        model_config: HFModelConfig = omega_conf_to_dataclass(self.config.actor_rollout_ref.model)
        self.tokenizer = model_config.tokenizer
        # Used for multimodal LLM, could be None
        self.processor = model_config.processor

    def _init_dataloader(self):
        """Initialize train and validate dataloader."""
        self.train_dataset = create_rl_dataset(
            self.config.data.train_files,
            self.config.data,
            self.tokenizer,
            self.processor,
            is_train=True,
            max_samples=self.config.data.get("train_max_samples", -1),
        )
        self.val_dataset = create_rl_dataset(
            self.config.data.val_files,
            self.config.data,
            self.tokenizer,
            self.processor,
            is_train=False,
            max_samples=self.config.data.get("val_max_samples", -1),
        )

        # Exact refill counts require single-prompt dataloader fetches.
        filter_groups = self.config.algorithm.get("filter_groups", None)
        dapo_enabled = bool(filter_groups is not None and filter_groups.get("enable", False))
        sync_refill_failed_groups = bool(self.config.trainer.v1.sampler.get("sync_refill_failed_groups", False))
        requires_exact_refill = self.trainer_mode != "sync" or dapo_enabled or sync_refill_failed_groups
        if requires_exact_refill:
            user_gen_batch_size = self.config.data.get("gen_batch_size", None)
            if user_gen_batch_size not in (None, 1):
                logger.warning(f"data.gen_batch_size={user_gen_batch_size} is overridden to 1.")
            elif user_gen_batch_size is None:
                logger.info("data.gen_batch_size defaulted to 1.")
            with open_dict(self.config):
                self.config.data.gen_batch_size = 1

513	            f"parameter_sync_step ({self.parameter_sync_step})"
514	        )
515	        sample_batch_size = train_batch_size // self.parameter_sync_step
516	
517	        self._add_batch_to_generate()
518	
519	        metrics_aggregator = MetricsAggregator()
520	        combined_keys: list = []
521	        combined_tags: list = []
522	        combined_partition_id = "train"
523	        for trigger_idx in range(self.parameter_sync_step):
524	            self.local_trigger_step = trigger_idx
525	            iter_metrics: dict = {}
526	            batch = self._step_once(iter_metrics, timing_raw, sample_batch_size)
527	            sample_count = sum(not tag.get("is_padding", False) for tag in batch.tags)
528	            metrics_aggregator.add_step_metrics(iter_metrics, sample_count=sample_count)
529	            combined_keys.extend(batch.keys)
530	            combined_tags.extend(batch.tags)
531	            combined_partition_id = batch.partition_id
532	
533	        metrics.update(metrics_aggregator.get_aggregated_metrics())
534	        return KVBatchMeta(partition_id=combined_partition_id, keys=combined_keys, tags=combined_tags)
535	
536	    def _step_once(self, metrics: dict, timing_raw: dict, sample_batch_size: int) -> KVBatchMeta:
537	        """Run a single local update: sample one mini-batch and perform the full PPO pipeline once."""
538	        # 1. sample batch from replay buffer
539	        with marked_timer("gen", timing_raw, color="red"):
540	            self.on_sample_begin()
541	            batch, off_policy_metrics = self.replay_buffer.sample(
542	                global_steps=self.global_steps,
543	                partition_id="train",
544	                batch_size=sample_batch_size,
545	            )
546	            metrics.update(off_policy_metrics)
547	            batch.extra_info["temperature"] = self.config.actor_rollout_ref.rollout.temperature
548	            self.on_sample_end()
549	
550	        # 2. [OPTIONAL] compute reward score with colocated reward model
551	        if self.reward_loop_manager.reward_loop_worker_handles is None:
552	            with marked_timer("reward", timing_raw, color="yellow"):
553	                batch = self._compute_reward_colocate(batch, metrics=metrics)
554	
555	        # 3. balance batch across data parallel groups
556	        batch = self._balance_batch(batch, metrics=metrics)
557	
558	        # 4. compute old_log_prob
559	        with marked_timer("old_log_prob", timing_raw, color="blue"):
560	            batch = self._compute_old_log_prob(batch, metrics=metrics)
561	
562	        # 5. [OPTIONAL] compute ref_log_prob
563	        if self.use_reference_policy:
564	            with marked_timer("ref", timing_raw, color="olive"):
565	                batch = self._compute_ref_log_prob(batch, metrics=metrics)
566	
567	        # 6. [OPTIONAL] compute critic values
568	        if self.use_critic:
569	            with marked_timer("values", timing_raw, color="cyan"):
570	                batch = self._compute_values(batch, metrics=metrics)
571	
572	        # 7. compute advantage and return
573	        with marked_timer("adv", timing_raw, color="brown"):
574	            batch = self._compute_advantage(batch, metrics=metrics)
575	
576	        # 8. [OPTIONAL] update critic
577	        if self.use_critic:
578	            with marked_timer("update_critic", timing_raw, color="pink"):
579	                batch = self._update_critic(batch, metrics=metrics)
580	
581	        # 9. update actor
582	        if self.config.trainer.critic_warmup <= self.global_steps:
583	            with marked_timer("update_actor", timing_raw, color="red"):
584	                batch = self._update_actor(batch, metrics=metrics)
585	
586	        return batch

34	def _accumulate_eviction_metrics(acc: dict, new: dict, stale_count: int) -> None:
35	    """Merge one poll iteration's eviction metrics into ``acc`` in place.
36	
37	    ``stale_count`` weights the staleness mean so it stays a true per-sample average across iterations.
38	    """
39	    stale_count_key = next((k for k in new if k.endswith("/off_policy/evicted_samples")), None)
40	    prev_stale_total = acc.get(stale_count_key, 0) if stale_count_key else 0
41	
42	    for key, value in new.items():
43	        if key.endswith("/evicted_samples_staleness/mean"):
44	            denom = prev_stale_total + stale_count
45	            acc[key] = (acc.get(key, 0.0) * prev_stale_total + value * stale_count) / denom if denom else value
46	        elif key.endswith("/evicted_samples_staleness/max"):
47	            acc[key] = max(acc.get(key, value), value)
48	        elif key.endswith("/evicted_samples_staleness/min"):
49	            acc[key] = min(acc.get(key, value), value)
50	        elif key == DAPO_FILTERED_REWARD_COUNTS_KEY:
51	            # Dict-valued diagnostic: merge {metric_value: count} across poll iterations.
52	            merged = Counter(acc.get(key, {}))
53	            merged.update(value)
54	            acc[key] = dict(merged)
55	        else:
56	            acc[key] = acc.get(key, 0) + value
